**25. `src/components/ui/Button.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx'; // Utility for conditionally joining class names

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  children,
  className,
  isLoading,
  disabled,
  ...props
}) => {
  const baseStyles =
    'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md font-medium transition-colors duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed';

  const variantStyles = {
    primary: 'bg-primary text-white hover:bg-blue-600 focus:ring-primary',
    secondary: 'bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-orange-600 focus:ring-secondary',
    danger: 'bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600 focus:ring-red-500',
    outline: 'border border-current text-current hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 focus:ring-gray-400',
    ghost: 'hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 text-current focus:ring-gray-400',
  };

  const sizeStyles = {
    sm: 'px-3 py-1 text-sm',
    md: 'px-4 py-2 text-base',
    lg: 'px-5 py-3 text-lg',
  };

  return (
    <button
      className={clsx(baseStyles, variantStyles[variant], sizeStyles[size], className)}
      disabled={disabled || isLoading}
      {...props}
    >
      {isLoading ? (
        <svg
          className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-white"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        >
          <circle
            className="opacity-25"
            cx="12"
            cy="12"
            r="10"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="4"
          ></circle>
          <path
            className="opacity-75"
            fill="currentColor"
            d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"
          ></path>
        </svg>
      ) : (
        children
      )}
    </button>
  );
};

export default Button;
```

**26. `src/components/ui/Input.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';

interface InputProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label?: string;
  error?: string;
}

const Input = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
  ({ label, error, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const baseStyles =
      'block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white';
    const errorStyles = 'border-red-500 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500';

    return (
      <div className="mb-4">
        {label && (
          <label htmlFor={props.id} className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <input
          ref={ref}
          className={clsx(baseStyles, { [errorStyles]: error }, className)}
          {...props}
        />
        {error && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

Input.displayName = 'Input'; // Add display name for forwardRef
export default Input;
```

**27. `src/components/ui/Modal.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import Button from './Button';
import { useTranslation } from '../../hooks/useTranslation';

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
  showCloseButton?: boolean;
}

const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  footer,
  size = 'md',
  showCloseButton = true,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Prevent scrolling background
    } else {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'max-w-sm',
    md: 'max-w-md',
    lg: 'max-w-lg',
    xl: 'max-w-xl',
  };

  return ReactDOM.createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black bg-opacity-50 p-4"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (modalRef.current && !modalRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        className={`relative w-full transform rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-xl transition-all dark:bg-darkBg ${sizeClasses[size]}`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{title}</h3>
          {showCloseButton && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label={t('generic.cancel')}
              className="hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-600"
            >
              <svg
                className="h-6 w-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                ></path>
              </svg>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">{children}</div>
        {footer && <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">{footer}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
};

export default Modal;
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';

interface SelectOption {
  value: string | number;
  label: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

interface SelectProps extends React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
  label?: string;
  options: SelectOption[];
  error?: string;
}

const Select = React.forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectProps>(
  ({ label, options, error, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const baseStyles =
      'block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white';
    const errorStyles = 'border-red-500 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500';

    return (
      <div className="mb-4">
        {label && (
          <label htmlFor={props.id} className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <select
          ref={ref}
          className={clsx(baseStyles, { [errorStyles]: error }, className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {options.map((option) => (
            <option key={option.value} value={option.value} disabled={option.disabled}>
              {option.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {error && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

Select.displayName = 'Select';
export default Select;
```

**30. `src/components/DiceRoll.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { playSound } from '../utils/helpers';
import { SOUND_PATHS } from '../utils/constants';

interface DiceProps {
  value: number | null; // The number to display when settled
  onRollComplete?: () => void;
  rolling: boolean;
}

const DiceRoll: React.FC<DiceProps> = ({ value, onRollComplete, rolling }) => {
  const { settings } = useGame();
  const [displayValue, setDisplayValue] = useState<number | null>(value);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rolling && settings.enableDiceAnimation) {
      setIsAnimating(true);
      playSound(SOUND_PATHS.diceRoll, settings.enableSoundEffects);
      const animationDuration = 500; // Matches Tailwind animation duration
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsAnimating(false);
        setDisplayValue(value);
        onRollComplete?.();
      }, animationDuration);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    } else if (value !== null && !rolling) {
      setDisplayValue(value);
    }
  }, [rolling, value, onRollComplete, settings.enableDiceAnimation, settings.enableSoundEffects]);

  return (
    <div
      className={clsx(
        'relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-white shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 dark:bg-gray-800',
        {
          'animate-roll': isAnimating,
        },
      )}
    >
      <span className="text-4xl font-bold text-gray-800 dark:text-white">
        {isAnimating ? '?' : displayValue}
      </span>
      {/* Basic representation of dice dots - could be improved with SVGs */}
      {!isAnimating && displayValue && (
        <>
          {displayValue === 1 && <span className="absolute h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>}
          {displayValue === 2 && (
            <>
              <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
            </>
          )}
          {displayValue === 3 && (
            <>
              <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
            </>
          )}
          {displayValue === 4 && (
            <>
              <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute left-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
            </>
          )}
          {displayValue === 5 && (
            <>
              <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute left-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
            </>
          )}
          {displayValue === 6 && (
            <>
              <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute left-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute left-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
              <span className="absolute right-2 bottom-2 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black dark:bg-white"></span>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DiceRoll;
```

**31. `src/components/Scoreboard.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { MatchState, Team } from '../types';
import { formatOvers } from '../utils/helpers';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

interface ScoreboardProps {
  matchState: MatchState;
  team1: Team;
  team2: Team;
}

const Scoreboard: React.FC<ScoreboardProps> = ({ matchState, team1, team2 }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const inningsKeys = Object.keys(matchState.innings);
  const currentInnings = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[inningsKeys.length - 1]];

  const battingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team1 : team2;
  const bowlingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team2 : team1;

  const currentOverDisplay = formatOvers(currentInnings.balls, currentInnings.legalBalls);

  return (
    <div className="w-full rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 p-4 text-white shadow-xl dark:from-gray-700 dark:to-gray-900">
      <h2 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold md:text-2xl">
        {t('match.currentMatch')}
      </h2>
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between text-lg md:text-xl">
        <div className="font-semibold">{battingTeam.name}</div>
        <div className="text-right text-2xl font-bold md:text-3xl">
          {currentInnings.score}/{currentInnings.wickets}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm md:text-base">
        <div>
          {t('match.overs')}: <span className="font-semibold">{currentOverDisplay}</span> (
          {matchState.format.overs})
        </div>
        <div>
          {t('match.wickets')}:{' '}
          <span className="font-semibold">
            {currentInnings.wickets}/{matchState.format.wickets}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {matchState.currentInnings === 2 && matchState.target > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-2 text-center text-sm font-semibold md:text-base">
          {t('match.target')}: {matchState.target} ({matchState.target - currentInnings.score}{' '}
          {t('match.runsRequired')})
        </div>
      )}

      {currentInnings.currentBatsmanId && (
        <div className="mt-4 border-t border-blue-400 pt-3 dark:border-gray-600">
          <div className="flex justify-between">
            <span className="font-semibold">{t('match.batsman')}:</span>
            <span>
              {battingTeam.players.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBatsmanId)?.name ||
                'N/A'}
            </span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-yellow-300">
              {currentInnings.individualScores[currentInnings.currentBatsmanId]?.runs || 0} (
              {currentInnings.individualScores[currentInnings.currentBatsmanId]?.balls || 0})
            </span>
          </div>
          {currentInnings.secondBatsmanId && (
            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm text-blue-100 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">
              <span className="">{t('match.batsman')}:</span>
              <span>
                {battingTeam.players.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.secondBatsmanId)?.name ||
                  'N/A'}
              </span>
              <span>
                {currentInnings.individualScores[currentInnings.secondBatsmanId]?.runs || 0} (
                {currentInnings.individualScores[currentInnings.secondBatsmanId]?.balls || 0})
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {currentInnings.currentBowlerId && (
        <div className="mt-3 border-t border-blue-400 pt-3 dark:border-gray-600">
          <div className="flex justify-between">
            <span className="font-semibold">{t('match.bowler')}:</span>
            <span>
              {bowlingTeam.players.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBowlerId)?.name ||
                'N/A'}
            </span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-yellow-300">
              {currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentInnings.currentBowlerId]?.wickets || 0}/
              {currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentInnings.currentBowlerId]?.runsConceded || 0}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Scoreboard;
```

```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

interface CommentaryPanelProps {
  log: string[];
}

const CommentaryPanel: React.FC<CommentaryPanelProps> = ({ log }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const logEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    logEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [log]);

  return (
    <div className="h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg bg-gray-100 p-4 shadow-inner dark:bg-gray-800 md:h-64">
      <h3 className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('commentary.title') || 'Commentary'}
      </h3>
      <div className="space-y-1 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
        {log.map((entry, index) => (
          <p key={index} className="leading-tight">
            {entry}
          </p>
        ))}
        <div ref={logEndRef} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CommentaryPanel;
```

**33. `src/components/MatchControls.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import Button from './ui/Button';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

interface MatchControlsProps {
  isUserBatting: boolean;
  isUserBowler: boolean;
  onRoll: (batsmanRoll?: number, bowlerRoll?: number) => void;
  onNextInnings?: () => void;
  onViewScorecard?: () => void;
  onQuitMatch?: () => void;
  isRolling: boolean;
  showNextInningsButton: boolean;
  showViewScorecardButton: boolean;
  showResumeButton: boolean;
}

const MatchControls: React.FC<MatchControlsProps> = ({
  isUserBatting,
  isUserBowler,
  onRoll,
  onNextInnings,
  onViewScorecard,
  onQuitMatch,
  isRolling,
  showNextInningsButton,
  showViewScorecardButton,
  showResumeButton,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const handleRoll = (role: 'batsman' | 'bowler') => {
    const rollValue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1; // Simulate dice roll 1-6
    if (role === 'batsman') {
      onRoll(rollValue, undefined);
    } else {
      onRoll(undefined, rollValue);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col space-y-4 md:flex-row md:space-x-4 md:space-y-0">
      {isUserBatting && (
        <Button
          onClick={() => handleRoll('batsman')}
          disabled={isRolling}
          isLoading={isRolling}
          className="w-full"
        >
          {t('match.rollAsBatsman')}
        </Button>
      )}
      {isUserBowler && (
        <Button
          onClick={() => handleRoll('bowler')}
          disabled={isRolling}
          isLoading={isRolling}
          className="w-full"
        >
          {t('match.rollAsBowler')}
        </Button>
      )}

      {showNextInningsButton && (
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onNextInnings} className="w-full">
          {t('match.newInnings')}
        </Button>
      )}

      {showViewScorecardButton && (
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onViewScorecard} className="w-full">
          {t('match.viewScorecard')}
        </Button>
      )}

      {showResumeButton && (
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={onRoll} className="w-full">
          {t('match.resume')}
        </Button>
      )}

      {onQuitMatch && (
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={onQuitMatch} className="w-full">
          {t('match.quit')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchControls;
```

**34. `src/components/MatchSummaryModal.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import Modal from './ui/Modal';
import Button from './ui/Button';
import { MatchResult, MatchState, Team } from '../types';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

interface MatchSummaryModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  matchResult: MatchResult | null;
  matchState: MatchState;
  team1: Team;
  team2: Team;
  onViewScorecard: () => void;
}

const MatchSummaryModal: React.FC<MatchSummaryModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  matchResult,
  matchState,
  team1,
  team2,
  onViewScorecard,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (!matchResult) return null;

  const getTeamName = (teamId: string) => {
    if (teamId === team1.id) return team1.name;
    if (teamId === team2.id) return team2.name;
    return 'N/A';
  };

  const getResultTitle = () => {
    switch (matchResult.type) {
      case 'WIN_BY_RUNS':
      case 'WIN_BY_WICKETS':
        return `${getTeamName(matchResult.winningTeamId!)} ${t('match.gameOver')}`;
      case 'TIE':
        return t('match.draw');
      case 'DRAW':
        return t('match.draw');
      default:
        return t('match.gameOver');
    }
  };

  const footer = (
    <>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={onViewScorecard}>
        {t('match.viewScorecard')}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
        {t('scorecard.goToHome')}
      </Button>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={getResultTitle()}
      footer={footer}
      size="md"
      showCloseButton={false} // Force user to view scorecard or go home
    >
      <div className="text-center text-lg">
        <p className="mb-4 text-2xl font-bold">{matchResult.message}</p>
        <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          {t('match.matchOver')}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default MatchSummaryModal;
```

**35. `src/components/ScorecardDisplay.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { Innings, MatchState, Player, Team } from '../types';
import { calculateEconomy, calculateStrikeRate, formatOvers, getPlayerName } from '../utils/helpers';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import { OVERS_PER_OVER } from '../utils/constants';

interface ScorecardDisplayProps {
  innings: Innings;
  matchState: MatchState;
  allTeams: Team[]; // Array of all teams to find player names
}

const ScorecardDisplay: React.FC<ScorecardDisplayProps> = ({ innings, matchState, allTeams }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const getTeamById = (id: string) => allTeams.find((t) => t.id === id);
  const battingTeam = getTeamById(innings.teamId);
  const bowlingTeamId =
    matchState.team1Id === innings.teamId ? matchState.team2Id : matchState.team1Id;
  const bowlingTeam = getTeamById(bowlingTeamId);

  const getPlayer = (playerId: string, team: Team | undefined) =>
    team?.players.find((p) => p.id === playerId);

  const renderBatsmen = () => {
    const sortedBatsmen = Object.entries(innings.individualScores)
      .map(([playerId, stats]) => ({
        player: getPlayer(playerId, battingTeam) || { ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: playerId, name: 'Unknown' },
        stats,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.player.battingOrder - b.player.battingOrder); // Sort by batting order

    return (
      <div className="mb-6 overflow-x-auto">
        <h4 className="mb-3 text-lg font-semibold">{t('scorecard.batsman')}</h4>
        <table className="min-w-full table-auto border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-gray-200 text-left dark:bg-gray-700">
              <th className="px-4 py-2">{t('scorecard.batsman')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.runs')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.balls')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.sRate')}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {sortedBatsmen.map(({ player, stats }) => (
              <tr key={player.id} className="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                <td className="px-4 py-2">
                  {player.name} {stats.isOut ? `(${stats.outText || 'out'})` : `(${t('scorecard.notOut')})`}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{stats.runs}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{stats.balls}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{calculateStrikeRate(stats.runs, stats.balls)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderBowling = () => {
    const sortedBowlers = Object.entries(innings.bowlingStats)
      .map(([playerId, stats]) => ({
        player: getPlayer(playerId, bowlingTeam) || { ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: playerId, name: 'Unknown' },
        stats,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.player.battingOrder - b.player.battingOrder); // Simple sort for now

    return (
      <div className="mb-6 overflow-x-auto">
        <h4 className="mb-3 text-lg font-semibold">{t('scorecard.bowler')}</h4>
        <table className="min-w-full table-auto border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-gray-200 text-left dark:bg-gray-700">
              <th className="px-4 py-2">{t('scorecard.bowler')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.overs')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.maidens')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.runs')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.wickets')}</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{t('scorecard.economy')}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {sortedBowlers.map(({ player, stats }) => (
              <tr key={player.id} className="border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                <td className="px-4 py-2">{player.name}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{formatOvers(stats.balls, stats.balls)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{stats.maidens}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{stats.runsConceded}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{stats.wickets}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{calculateEconomy(stats.runsConceded, stats.balls)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderFallOfWickets = () => {
    if (innings.fallOfWickets.length === 0) return null;

    return (
      <div className="mb-6">
        <h4 className="mb-3 text-lg font-semibold">{t('scorecard.fallOfWickets')}</h4>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
          {innings.fallOfWickets.map((fow, index) => (
            <span key={index} className="rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-3 py-1 text-sm dark:bg-gray-700">
              {fow.wicketNum}-{fow.score} ({getPlayerName(battingTeam, fow.playerId)})
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800">
      <h3 className="mb-4 text-2xl font-bold">
        {battingTeam?.name} - {t('scorecard.innings')} {innings.id.split('-')[0]}
      </h3>
      <div className="mb-4 flex justify-between text-lg font-semibold">
        <span>
          {t('scorecard.total')}: {innings.score}/{innings.wickets}
        </span>
        <span>
          ({formatOvers(innings.balls, innings.legalBalls)} {t('scorecard.overs')})
        </span>
      </div>

      {renderBatsmen()}
      {renderBowling()}
      {renderFallOfWickets()}

      <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">
        <span className="font-semibold">{t('scorecard.extras')}: {innings.extras}</span>
        <span className="font-semibold">{t('scorecard.total')}: {innings.score}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ScorecardDisplay;
```

```typescript
    <div
      className={`relative rounded-lg border-2 p-4 shadow-md ${
        isSelected
          ? 'border-primary ring-2 ring-primary'

            {t('generic.edit')}
          </Button>
```

```typescript
        min="1"

      />
```

**39. `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { Team } from '../types';
import clsx from 'clsx';

interface TournamentBracketProps {
  bracket: string[][]; // 2D array of team IDs or 'TBD'
  allTeams: Team[];
  onViewMatch?: (matchId: string) => void; // Optional: to view a specific match
}

const TournamentBracket: React.FC<TournamentBracketProps> = ({ bracket, allTeams, onViewMatch }) => {
  const getTeamName = (teamId: string) => {
    if (teamId === 'BYE') return 'BYE';
    if (teamId.startsWith('TBD')) return teamId.replace('TBD', 'Winner');
    return allTeams.find((t) => t.id === teamId)?.name || 'Unknown Team';
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex justify-center overflow-x-auto p-4">
      {bracket.map((round, roundIndex) => (
        <div key={roundIndex} className="mx-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-around">
          <h4 className="mb-4 text-lg font-bold">Round {roundIndex + 1}</h4>
          {round.map((teamId, index) => {
            // Determine if it's a match winner placeholder or an actual team
            const isMatchPlaceholder = teamId.startsWith('TBD');
            const isBye = teamId === 'BYE';

            return (
              <div
                key={`${roundIndex}-${index}`}
                className={clsx(
                  'my-2 flex min-h-[50px] w-48 items-center justify-center rounded-md border p-2 text-center text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200',
                  {
                    'border-gray-400 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300': isMatchPlaceholder,
                    'border-green-400 bg-green-50 text-green-700 dark:border-green-700 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-300': !isMatchPlaceholder && !isBye,
                    'border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-500 dark:bg-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400': isBye,
                    'cursor-pointer hover:bg-green-100 dark:hover:bg-green-800': onViewMatch && !isMatchPlaceholder && !isBye,
                  },
                )}
                onClick={() => !isMatchPlaceholder && !isBye && onViewMatch?.(teamId)} // Placeholder for linking to match
              >
                {getTeamName(teamId)}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TournamentBracket;
```

**40. `src/components/SettingsForm.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { GameSettings, Difficulty } from '../types';
import Button from './ui/Button';
import Select from './ui/Select';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

interface SettingsFormProps {
  settings: GameSettings;
  onUpdate: (newSettings: GameSettings) => void;
  onSave: () => void;
}

const SettingsForm: React.FC<SettingsFormProps> = ({ settings, onUpdate, onSave }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const handleDifficultyChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    onUpdate({ ...settings, difficulty: e.target.value as Difficulty });
  };

  const handleToggleChange = (key: keyof GameSettings) => {
    onUpdate({ ...settings, [key]: !settings[key] });
  };

  const handleThemeChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    onUpdate({ ...settings, theme: e.target.value as 'light' | 'dark' });
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800">
      <h2 className="mb-4 text-2xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('settings.title')}
      </h2>

      <div className="mb-6">
        <Select
          label={t('settings.difficulty')}
          value={settings.difficulty}
          onChange={handleDifficultyChange}
          options={[
            { value: Difficulty.EASY, label: t('settings.easy') },
            { value: Difficulty.MEDIUM, label: t('settings.medium') },
            { value: Difficulty.HARD, label: t('settings.hard') },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="mb-6">
        <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
          {t('settings.theme')}
        </label>
        <Select
          value={settings.theme}
          onChange={handleThemeChange}
          options={[
            { value: 'light', label: t('settings.light') },
            { value: 'dark', label: t('settings.dark') },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="mb-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="diceAnimationToggle" className="text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('settings.enableDiceAnimation')}
          </label>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="diceAnimationToggle"
            checked={settings.enableDiceAnimation}
            onChange={() => handleToggleChange('enableDiceAnimation')}
            className="h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="soundEffectsToggle" className="text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('settings.enableSoundEffects')}
          </label>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="soundEffectsToggle"
            checked={settings.enableSoundEffects}
            onChange={() => handleToggleChange('enableSoundEffects')}
            className="h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="extrasToggle" className="text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('settings.enableExtras')}
          </label>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="extrasToggle"
            checked={settings.enableExtras}
            onChange={() => handleToggleChange('enableExtras')}
            className="h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button onClick={onSave} variant="primary" className="w-full">
        {t('settings.saveSettings')}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsForm;
```
