**41. `src/pages/Home.tsx`**
```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import { formatTime } from '../utils/helpers';

const Home: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { currentMatch, savedMatches, setCurrentMatch, deleteMatch } = useGame();
  const [showContinueModal, setShowContinueModal] = React.useState(false);
  const [matchToDelete, setMatchToDelete] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showDeleteConfirm, setShowDeleteConfirm] = React.useState(false);

  const savedMatchesList = Object.values(savedMatches).sort((a, b) => b.lastPlayedAt - a.lastPlayedAt);
  const activeMatches = savedMatchesList.filter(m => m.status === 'active');
  const completedMatches = savedMatchesList.filter(m => m.status === 'completed');

  const handleContinueMatch = (matchId: string) => {
    setCurrentMatch(matchId);
    navigate(`/match/${matchId}`);
  };

  const handleDeleteMatch = (matchId: string) => {
    setMatchToDelete(matchId);
    setShowDeleteConfirm(true);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (matchToDelete) {
      deleteMatch(matchToDelete);
      setMatchToDelete(null);
      setShowDeleteConfirm(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-8 text-4xl font-extrabold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('home.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col space-y-4">
        <Link to="/match-setup">
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.newMatch')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        {activeMatches.length > 0 ? (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full" onClick={() => setShowContinueModal(true)}>
            {t('home.continueMatch')}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full" disabled>
            {t('home.noSavedMatch')}
          </Button>
        )}

        <Link to="/tournaments">
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.tournaments')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        <Link to="/team-editor">
          <Button variant="outline" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.teamEditor')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        <Link to="/settings">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.settings')}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showContinueModal}
        onClose={() => setShowContinueModal(false)}
        title={t('home.continueMatch')}
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {activeMatches.map((match) => (
            <div
              key={match.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-gray-100 p-3 dark:bg-gray-700"
            >
              <div>
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {savedMatches[match.id]?.team1Players[0]?.name || 'Team 1'} vs{' '}
                  {savedMatches[match.id]?.team2Players[0]?.name || 'Team 2'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                  {match.format.type} | {t('generic.lastPlayed')}: {formatTime(Date.now() - match.lastPlayedAt)} ago
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex space-x-2">
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => handleContinueMatch(match.id)}>
                  {t('match.resume')}
                </Button>
                <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => handleDeleteMatch(match.id)}>
                  {t('generic.delete')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {activeMatches.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              {t('home.noSavedMatch')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showDeleteConfirm}
        onClose={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}
        title={t('generic.confirmDelete')}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}>
              {t('generic.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={confirmDelete}>
              {t('generic.delete')}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-center text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
          {t('generic.areYouSureDeleteMatch')}
        </p>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Home;
```

**42. `src/pages/MatchSetup.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import {
  GameFormat,
  TossDecision,
  MatchFormat,
  Team,
  DEFAULT_TEAM,
  Difficulty,
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS } from '../utils/constants';
import { initializeMatch } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Select from '../components/ui/Select';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import TeamCard from '../components/TeamCard';

const MatchSetup: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { teams, saveMatch, settings, setCurrentMatch } = useGame();

  const [selectedFormatType, setSelectedFormatType] = useState<GameFormat>(GameFormat.T20);
  const [customOvers, setCustomOvers] = useState<number>(5);
  const [customWickets, setCustomWickets] = useState<number>(5);
  const [userTeamId, setUserTeamId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiTeamId, setAiTeamId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [userWinsToss, setUserWinsToss] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [userTossDecision, setUserTossDecision] = useState<TossDecision | null>(null);
  const [enableExtras, setEnableExtras] = useState<boolean>(settings.enableExtras);
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState<Difficulty>(settings.difficulty);

  const [showTeamSelectModal, setShowTeamSelectModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectingFor, setSelectingFor] = useState<'user' | 'ai' | null>(null);

  const availableTeams = teams.filter(
    (team) => team.id !== userTeamId && team.id !== aiTeamId,
  );
  const currentUserTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === userTeamId);
  const currentAiTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === aiTeamId);

  const handleStartMatch = () => {
    if (!userTeamId || !aiTeamId) {
      alert(t('matchSetup.selectTeams'));
      return;
    }

    const userTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === userTeamId);
    const aiTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === aiTeamId);

    if (!userTeam || !aiTeam) {
      alert(t('generic.error'));
      return;
    }

    let matchFormat: MatchFormat;
    if (selectedFormatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM) {
      matchFormat = {
        type: GameFormat.CUSTOM,
        overs: customOvers,
        wickets: customWickets,
        inningsPerSide: 1, // Custom matches usually single innings for simplicity
      };
    } else {
      matchFormat = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[selectedFormatType];
    }

    // Determine actual toss outcome if not yet decided by user
    const finalUserWinsToss = userWinsToss === null ? Math.random() < 0.5 : userWinsToss;

    // AI's toss decision if AI wins toss
    const finalUserTossDecision = finalUserWinsToss && userTossDecision !== null ? userTossDecision : null;

    const initialMatchState = initializeMatch(
      matchFormat,
      userTeam,
      aiTeam,
      finalUserWinsToss,
      finalUserTossDecision,
      { ...settings, enableExtras, difficulty }, // Pass current settings to match
    );

    saveMatch(initialMatchState);
    setCurrentMatch(initialMatchState.id); // Set as current match
    navigate(`/match/${initialMatchState.id}`);
  };

  const handleSelectTeam = (team: Team) => {
    if (selectingFor === 'user') {
      setUserTeamId(team.id);
    } else if (selectingFor === 'ai') {
      setAiTeamId(team.id);
    }
    setShowTeamSelectModal(false);
    setSelectingFor(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4 md:max-w-xl">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('matchSetup.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800">
        <Select
          label={t('matchSetup.format')}
          value={selectedFormatType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedFormatType(e.target.value as GameFormat)}
          options={Object.values(GameFormat).map((format) => ({
            value: format,
            label: format,
          }))}
        />

        {selectedFormatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.overs')}
              type="number"
              value={customOvers}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomOvers(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.wickets')}
              type="number"
              value={customWickets}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomWickets(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mb-4 flex space-x-4">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.yourTeam')}
            </p>
            {currentUserTeam ? (
              <div
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-2 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('user');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
              >
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentUserTeam.name}</span>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  {t('generic.change')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('user');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
                className="w-full"
              >
                {t('generic.select')} {t('teamEditor.team')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.aiTeam')}
            </p>
            {currentAiTeam ? (
              <div
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-2 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('ai');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
              >
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentAiTeam.name}</span>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  {t('generic.change')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('ai');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
                className="w-full"
              >
                {t('generic.select')} {t('teamEditor.team')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.toss')}
          </label>
          <div className="flex space-x-4">
            <Button
              variant={userWinsToss === true ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setUserWinsToss(true)}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              {t('matchSetup.userWins')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={userWinsToss === false ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setUserWinsToss(false)}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              {t('matchSetup.aiWins')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {userWinsToss && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.chooseBatBowl')}
            </label>
            <div className="flex space-x-4">
              <Button
                variant={userTossDecision === TossDecision.BAT ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setUserTossDecision(TossDecision.BAT)}
                className="flex-1"
              >
                {t('matchSetup.batFirst')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant={userTossDecision === TossDecision.BOWL ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setUserTossDecision(TossDecision.BOWL)}
                className="flex-1"
              >
                {t('matchSetup.bowlFirst')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.difficulty')}
          </label>
          <Select
            value={difficulty}
            onChange={(e) => setDifficulty(e.target.value as Difficulty)}
            options={[
              { value: Difficulty.EASY, label: t('matchSetup.easy') },
              { value: Difficulty.MEDIUM, label: t('matchSetup.medium') },
              { value: Difficulty.HARD, label: t('matchSetup.hard') },
            ]}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="extrasToggle" className="text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.enableExtras')}
          </label>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="extrasToggle"
            checked={enableExtras}
            onChange={(e) => setEnableExtras(e.target.checked)}
            className="h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
          />
        </div>

        <Button
          onClick={handleStartMatch}
          variant="primary"
          size="lg"
          className="w-full"
          disabled={!userTeamId || !aiTeamId || (userWinsToss && !userTossDecision)}
        >
          {t('matchSetup.startMatch')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showTeamSelectModal}
        onClose={() => setShowTeamSelectModal(false)}
        title={t('generic.select') + ' ' + (selectingFor === 'user' ? t('matchSetup.yourTeam') : t('matchSetup.aiTeam'))}
        size="lg"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          {teams.map((team) => (
            <TeamCard
              key={team.id}
              team={team}
              onSelect={handleSelectTeam}
              isSelected={
                (selectingFor === 'user' && team.id === userTeamId) ||
                (selectingFor === 'ai' && team.id === aiTeamId)
              }
            />
          ))}
          {teams.length === 0 && (
            <p className="col-span-2 text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              No teams available. Go to Team Editor to create one.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchSetup;
```

**43. `src/pages/MatchPage.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  MatchState,
  MatchStage,
  Innings,
  BallOutcome,
  Team,
  DEFAULT_PLAYER,
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { resolveBall, checkInningsEnd, transitionInnings, calculateMatchResult } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import { playSound } from '../utils/helpers';
import { SOUND_PATHS } from '../utils/constants';

import Scoreboard from '../components/Scoreboard';
import CommentaryPanel from '../components/CommentaryPanel';
import MatchControls from '../components/MatchControls';
import DiceRoll from '../components/DiceRoll';
import MatchSummaryModal from '../components/MatchSummaryModal';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

const MatchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { getMatchById, saveMatch, getTeamById, setCurrentMatch, deleteMatch, settings } = useGame();

  const [matchState, setMatchState] = useState<MatchState | null>(null);
  const [team1, setTeam1] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [team2, setTeam2] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [isRolling, setIsRolling] = useState(false);
  const [batsmanDiceValue, setBatsmanDiceValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [bowlerDiceValue, setBowlerDiceValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [showMatchSummary, setShowMatchSummary] = useState(false);

  // useRef to hold match state and settings for async operations
  const matchStateRef = useRef<MatchState | null>(null);
  const settingsRef = useRef(settings);
  useEffect(() => {
    settingsRef.current = settings;
  }, [settings]);


  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      const loadedMatch = getMatchById(id);
      if (loadedMatch) {
        setMatchState(loadedMatch);
        matchStateRef.current = loadedMatch;
        const t1 = getTeamById(loadedMatch.team1Id);
        const t2 = getTeamById(loadedMatch.team2Id);
        setTeam1(t1 || null);
        setTeam2(t2 || null);
        setCurrentMatch(id); // Set this match as the active one
      } else {
        navigate('/'); // Redirect to home if match not found
      }
    }
  }, [id, getMatchById, navigate, getTeamById, setCurrentMatch]);

  // Autosave when matchState changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (matchState && matchState.status === 'active') {
      saveMatch(matchState);
    }
  }, [matchState, saveMatch]);

  const currentInnings: Innings | undefined = matchState
    ? matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[matchState.currentInnings - 1]]
    : undefined;

  const isCurrentInningsOver = currentInnings ? checkInningsEnd(currentInnings, matchState!.format) : false;
  const isMatchOver = matchState?.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;
  const isInningsBreak = matchState?.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK;

  const handleRollComplete = useCallback(
    (newMatchState: MatchState, outcome: BallOutcome | null) => {
      setIsRolling(false);
      setBatsmanDiceValue(outcome?.batsmanRoll || null);
      setBowlerDiceValue(outcome?.bowlerRoll || null);

      if (outcome?.isWicket) {
        playSound(SOUND_PATHS.wicket, settingsRef.current.enableSoundEffects);
      } else if (outcome?.runsScored && outcome.runsScored > 0) {
        playSound(SOUND_PATHS.runs, settingsRef.current.enableSoundEffects);
      } else if (outcome?.isExtra) {
        // Maybe a specific sound for extras
      }

      setMatchState(newMatchState);
      matchStateRef.current = newMatchState; // Update ref immediately

      // Check for match end condition after each ball (e.g. target chased)
      if (
        newMatchState.currentInnings === 2 &&
        newMatchState.target > 0 &&
        currentInnings &&
        currentInnings.score >= newMatchState.target
      ) {
        const finalState = {
          ...newMatchState,
          currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
          result: calculateMatchResult(newMatchState),
          status: 'completed',
        };
        setMatchState(finalState);
        matchStateRef.current = finalState;
        saveMatch(finalState); // Save final state
        setShowMatchSummary(true);
        return;
      }

      // Check for innings end
      if (newMatchState.currentInnings < newMatchState.format.inningsPerSide * 2) {
        const currentInningsAfterRoll =
          newMatchState.innings[Object.keys(newMatchState.innings)[newMatchState.currentInnings - 1]];
        if (checkInningsEnd(currentInningsAfterRoll, newMatchState.format)) {
          // If innings is over, transition to next state
          const transitionedState = transitionInnings(newMatchState);
          setMatchState(transitionedState);
          matchStateRef.current = transitionedState;
          if (transitionedState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
            saveMatch(transitionedState);
            setShowMatchSummary(true);
          }
        }
      } else {
        // If it was the last innings and it's over by wickets/overs, match is over
        const currentInningsAfterRoll =
            newMatchState.innings[Object.keys(newMatchState.innings)[newMatchState.currentInnings - 1]];
        if (checkInningsEnd(currentInningsAfterRoll, newMatchState.format)) {
            const finalState = {
                ...newMatchState,
                currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
                result: calculateMatchResult(newMatchState),
                status: 'completed',
            };
            setMatchState(finalState);
            matchStateRef.current = finalState;
            saveMatch(finalState);
            setShowMatchSummary(true);
        }
      }
    },
    [saveMatch, settings.enableSoundEffects, settingsRef, currentInnings],
  );

  const handleDiceRoll = useCallback(
    (batsmanRoll?: number, bowlerRoll?: number) => {
      if (!matchStateRef.current || isRolling) return; // Use ref for latest state
      setIsRolling(true);
      setBatsmanDiceValue(null); // Clear dice values for animation
      setBowlerDiceValue(null);

      // Simulate network/delay for animation effect
      setTimeout(() => {
        const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
          matchStateRef.current!,
          batsmanRoll || null,
          bowlerRoll || null,
          true,
        );
        handleRollComplete(updatedMatchState, ballOutcome);
      }, settingsRef.current.enableDiceAnimation ? 500 : 0); // Delay only if animation is enabled
    },
    [isRolling, handleRollComplete, settingsRef],
  );

  const handleNextInnings = () => {
    if (matchState) {
      const transitionedState = transitionInnings(matchState);
      setMatchState(transitionedState);
      matchStateRef.current = transitionedState;
      if (transitionedState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
        saveMatch(transitionedState);
        setShowMatchSummary(true);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleViewScorecard = () => {
    if (matchState?.id) {
      navigate(`/scorecard/${matchState.id}`);
      setShowMatchSummary(false); // Close summary modal if open
    }
  };

  const handleQuitMatch = () => {
    if (matchState) {
      const finalState = { ...matchState, status: 'paused', lastPlayedAt: Date.now() };
      saveMatch(finalState);
      setCurrentMatch(null); // Clear current match reference
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  if (!matchState || !team1 || !team2 || !currentInnings) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" className="text-primary" />
        <p className="ml-4 text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{t('generic.loading')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const battingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team1 : team2;
  const bowlingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team2 : team1;

  // Determine if player is batting or bowling
  const isUserBatting = matchState.isUserBatting && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;
  const isUserBowler = matchState.isUserBowler && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;

  const showNextInningsButton = isInningsBreak;
  const showViewScorecardButton = isMatchOver;
  const showResumeButton =
    matchState.status === 'paused' &&
    matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK &&
    matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Scoreboard */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Scoreboard matchState={matchState} team1={team1} team2={team2} />
        </div>

        {/* Dice & Controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-6 lg:col-span-1">
          <div className="flex space-x-8">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              <span className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {battingTeam.name}
              </span>
              <DiceRoll
                value={batsmanDiceValue}
                rolling={isRolling && (isUserBatting || !matchState.isUserBowler)} // AI rolls if user is not batting
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              <span className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {bowlingTeam.name}
              </span>
              <DiceRoll
                value={bowlerDiceValue}
                rolling={isRolling && (isUserBowler || !matchState.isUserBatting)} // AI rolls if user is not bowling
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <MatchControls
            isUserBatting={isUserBatting}
            isUserBowler={isUserBowler}
            onRoll={handleDiceRoll}
            onNextInnings={handleNextInnings}
            onViewScorecard={handleViewScorecard}
            onQuitMatch={handleQuitMatch}
            isRolling={isRolling}
            showNextInningsButton={showNextInningsButton}
            showViewScorecardButton={showViewScorecardButton}
            showResumeButton={showResumeButton}
          />

          {isMatchOver && (
            <div className="mt-4 text-center">
              <p className="mb-2 text-xl font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {t('match.matchOver')}
              </p>
              <Button onClick={() => setShowMatchSummary(true)} variant="primary">
                {t('match.viewScorecard')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Commentary */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1">
          <CommentaryPanel log={matchState.commentaryLog} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <MatchSummaryModal
        isOpen={showMatchSummary}
        onClose={() => setShowMatchSummary(false)}
        matchResult={matchState.result}
        matchState={matchState}
        team1={team1}
        team2={team2}
        onViewScorecard={handleViewScorecard}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchPage;
```

**44. `src/pages/ScorecardPage.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { MatchState, Team } from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import ScorecardDisplay from '../components/ScorecardDisplay';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

const ScorecardPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { getMatchById, teams } = useGame();

  const [matchState, setMatchState] = useState<MatchState | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      const loadedMatch = getMatchById(id);
      if (loadedMatch) {
        setMatchState(loadedMatch);
      } else {
        navigate('/'); // Redirect to home if match not found
      }
    }
  }, [id, getMatchById, navigate]);

  if (!matchState) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" className="text-primary" />
        <p className="ml-4 text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{t('generic.loading')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const team1 = teams.find((t) => t.id === matchState.team1Id);
  const team2 = teams.find((t) => t.id === matchState.team2Id);

  if (!team1 || !team2) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center p-4">
        <p className="text-lg text-red-500">Error: Teams not found for this match.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="mt-4">
          {t('scorecard.goToHome')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const inningsArray = Object.values(matchState.innings);

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('scorecard.matchSummary')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-blue-600 p-4 text-white shadow-xl dark:from-gray-700 dark:to-gray-900">
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-2xl font-bold">
          {team1.name} vs {team2.name}
        </h2>
        {matchState.result && (
          <p className="text-xl font-semibold">{matchState.result.message}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-8">
        {inningsArray.map((innings) => (
          <ScorecardDisplay key={innings.id} innings={innings} matchState={matchState} allTeams={teams} />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 flex justify-end space-x-4">
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
          {t('scorecard.goToHome')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ScorecardPage;
```

**45. `src/pages/TeamEditorPage.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { Player, Team, DEFAULT_PLAYER, DEFAULT_TEAM } from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import TeamCard from '../components/TeamCard';
import PlayerEditor from '../components/PlayerEditor';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

const TeamEditorPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { teams, addTeam, updateTeam, deleteTeam } = useGame();

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingTeam, setEditingTeam] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState<string>('');
  const [players, setPlayers] = useState<Player[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const openEditor = (team: Team | null = null) => {
    if (team) {
      setEditingTeam(team);
      setTeamName(team.name);
      setPlayers([...team.players].sort((a,b) => a.battingOrder - b.battingOrder)); // Ensure sorted for editing
    } else {
      setEditingTeam(null);
      setTeamName('New Team');
      setPlayers(
        Array(11)
          .fill(null)
          .map((_, i) => ({ ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: uuidv4(), name: `Player ${i + 1}`, battingOrder: i + 1 })),
      );
    }
    setError('');
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePlayerUpdate = (updatedPlayer: Player) => {
    setPlayers((prev) =>
      prev.map((p) => (p.id === updatedPlayer.id ? updatedPlayer : p)),
    );
  };

  const handlePlayerRemove = (playerId: string) => {
    setPlayers((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== playerId));
  };

  const handleAddPlayer = () => {
    setPlayers((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: uuidv4(), name: `Player ${prev.length + 1}`, battingOrder: prev.length + 1 },
    ]);
  };

  const handleSaveTeam = () => {
    if (!teamName.trim()) {
      setError('Team name cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }
    if (players.length < 11) {
      setError(t('teamEditor.minPlayers'));
      return;
    }

    // Ensure batting orders are unique and sequential if desired, or just use as entered
    const sortedPlayers = [...players].sort((a, b) => a.battingOrder - b.battingOrder);
    const uniqueOrderCheck = new Set(sortedPlayers.map(p => p.battingOrder));
    if (uniqueOrderCheck.size !== sortedPlayers.length) {
      setError("Batting orders must be unique.");
      return;
    }

    const teamToSave: Team = {
      id: editingTeam?.id || uuidv4(),
      name: teamName,
      players: sortedPlayers,
    };

    if (editingTeam) {
      updateTeam(teamToSave);
    } else {
      addTeam(teamToSave);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteTeam = (teamId: string) => {
    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this team?')) {
      deleteTeam(teamId);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('teamEditor.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between">
        <Button onClick={() => openEditor()} variant="primary">
          {t('teamEditor.newTeam')}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {teams.map((team) => (
          <TeamCard key={team.id} team={team} onEdit={openEditor} />
        ))}
        {teams.length === 0 && (
          <p className="col-span-full text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            No teams created yet. Click "New Team" to get started!
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title={editingTeam ? `${t('generic.edit')} ${teamName}` : t('teamEditor.newTeam')}
        size="xl"
      >
        <Input
          label={t('teamEditor.teamName')}
          value={teamName}
          onChange={(e) => setTeamName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('teamEditor.teamName')}
          error={error.includes('name') ? error : ''}
          className="mb-4"
        />

        <div className="mb-4 flex justify-between items-center">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('teamEditor.player')}s</h3>
            <Button onClick={handleAddPlayer} variant="secondary" size="sm">
                {t('teamEditor.addPlayer')}
            </Button>
        </div>


        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 p-2 dark:border-gray-700">
          {players.map((player, index) => (
            <PlayerEditor
              key={player.id}
              player={player}
              onUpdate={handlePlayerUpdate}
              onRemove={handlePlayerRemove}
              index={index}
            />
          ))}
          {error.includes('players') && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">
          {editingTeam && (
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteTeam(editingTeam.id)}>
              {t('teamEditor.deleteTeam')}
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>
            {t('generic.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSaveTeam}>
            {t('teamEditor.saveTeam')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TeamEditorPage;
```

**46. `src/pages/TournamentPage.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Tournament,
  TournamentType,
  GameFormat,
  Team,
  Difficulty,
  MatchState,
  MatchStage,
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import Select from '../components/ui/Select';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';
import TournamentTable from '../components/TournamentTable';
import TournamentBracket from '../components/TournamentBracket';
import { simulateFullMatch, transitionInnings } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import { calculateMatchResult, updateRoundRobinStandings } from '../utils/helpers';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';

const TournamentPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const {
    tournaments,
    teams: allTeams,
    createTournament,
    updateTournament,
    deleteTournament,
    saveMatch,
    getMatchById,
    getTeamById,
  } = useGame();

  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tournamentName, setTournamentName] = useState('');
  const [selectedTeams, setSelectedTeams] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [formatType, setFormatType] = useState<GameFormat>(GameFormat.T20);
  const [tournamentType, setTournamentType] = useState<TournamentType>(TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN);
  const [customOvers, setCustomOvers] = useState(5);
  const [customWickets, setCustomWickets] = useState(5);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [selectedTournament, setSelectedTournament] = useState<Tournament | null>(null);
  const [isTournamentDetailModalOpen, setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState(false);

  const availableTeams = allTeams.filter((t) => !selectedTeams.includes(t.id));

  const handleCreateTournament = () => {
    if (!tournamentName.trim()) {
      setError('Tournament name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (selectedTeams.length < 2) {
      setError('Please select at least 2 teams.');
      return;
    }
    if (formatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (customOvers < 1 || customWickets < 1)) {
      setError('Custom overs and wickets must be at least 1.');
      return;
    }

    createTournament(tournamentName, formatType, tournamentType, selectedTeams, customOvers, customWickets);
    setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
    resetForm();
  };

  const handleToggleTeam = (teamId: string) => {
    setSelectedTeams((prev) =>
      prev.includes(teamId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== teamId) : [...prev, teamId],
    );
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setTournamentName('');
    setSelectedTeams([]);
    setFormatType(GameFormat.T20);
    setTournamentType(TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN);
    setCustomOvers(5);
    setCustomWickets(5);
    setError('');
  };

  const openTournamentDetails = (tournament: Tournament) => {
    setSelectedTournament(tournament);
    setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleAutoPlayTournament = async () => {
    if (!selectedTournament) return;

    setIsSimulating(true);
    let currentTourn = { ...selectedTournament };
    currentTourn.status = 'in-progress';
    updateTournament(currentTourn); // Mark as in-progress

    const updatedMatches = [...currentTourn.matches];
    let updatedStandings = { ...currentTourn.standings.reduce((acc, stat) => ({...acc, [stat.teamId]: stat}), {}) };
    let currentBracket = currentTourn.bracket ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentTourn.bracket)) : undefined;

    for (let i = 0; i < updatedMatches.length; i++) {
      let match = { ...updatedMatches[i] };

      if (match.isPlayed) continue;

      // Handle BYE in knockout
      if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && (match.team1Id === 'BYE' || match.team2Id === 'BYE')) {
          const winnerId = match.team1Id === 'BYE' ? match.team2Id : match.team1Id;
          match.result = {
              type: 'WIN_BY_WICKETS', // Arbitrary win type for bye
              winningTeamId: winnerId,
              losingTeamId: match.team1Id === 'BYE' ? match.team1Id : match.team2Id, // The bye team is the 'loser'
              message: `${getTeamName(winnerId)} gets a bye!`,
          };
          match.isPlayed = true;
          match.matchStateId = uuidv4(); // Dummy ID for bye
          updatedMatches[i] = match;

          // Update bracket for the next round winner
          if (currentBracket) {
            const currentRoundIndex = match.round! -1;
            const nextRoundIndex = match.round!; // Next round is +1
            const matchSlotIndex = Math.floor((match.matchNumber!-1) / 2); // Which match slot in the next round
            if (currentBracket[nextRoundIndex] && currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex]) {
              currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex] = winnerId;
            }
          }
          continue;
      }


      const team1 = getTeamById(match.team1Id);
      const team2 = getTeamById(match.team2Id);

      if (!team1 || !team2) {
          console.error(`Teams not found for match ${match.id}`);
          continue;
      }

      const initialMatchState = initializeMatch(
        currentTourn.format,
        team1,
        team2,
        Math.random() < 0.5, // Random toss winner for AI vs AI
        Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'BAT' : 'BOWL', // Random toss decision for AI vs AI
        { difficulty: Difficulty.MEDIUM, enableDiceAnimation: false, enableSoundEffects: false, enableExtras: false, theme: 'light' } // Default settings for simulation
      );

      const finalMatchState = simulateFullMatch(initialMatchState, team1, team2);

      saveMatch(finalMatchState); // Save the simulated match

      match.matchStateId = finalMatchState.id;
      match.result = finalMatchState.result;
      match.isPlayed = true;
      updatedMatches[i] = match;

      if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN) {
        updatedStandings = updateRoundRobinStandings(
          currentTourn.teamIds,
          updatedStandings,
          match,
          team1,
          team2,
          finalMatchState,
        );
      } else if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && match.round) {
          // Update bracket for the next round winner
          if (currentBracket && match.result?.winningTeamId) {
            const currentRoundIndex = match.round -1; // rounds are 1-indexed, array 0-indexed
            const nextRoundIndex = match.round; // Next round
            const matchSlotIndex = Math.floor((match.matchNumber!-1) / 2); // Which match slot in the next round
            if (currentBracket[nextRoundIndex] && currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex]) {
              currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex] = match.result.winningTeamId;
            }
          }
      }

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(50)); // Small delay to avoid blocking UI
    }

    currentTourn.matches = updatedMatches;
    if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN) {
      currentTourn.standings = Object.values(updatedStandings);
    } else if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT) {
        currentTourn.bracket = currentBracket;
        // Check if a winner has been determined in the last round
        if (currentBracket && currentBracket.length > 0 && currentBracket[currentBracket.length - 1].length === 1 && currentBracket[currentBracket.length - 1][0] !== 'TBD') {
            currentTourn.status = 'completed';
        }
    }
    if (currentTourn.status !== 'completed') {
        currentTourn.status = 'in-progress';
    }
    updateTournament(currentTourn);
    setIsSimulating(false);
  };

  const getTeamName = (teamId: string) => allTeams.find((t) => t.id === teamId)?.name || teamId;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('tournament.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between">
        <Button onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)} variant="primary">
          {t('tournament.createTournament')}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {Object.values(tournaments).length === 0 && (
          <p className="col-span-full text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            {t('tournament.noTournaments')}
          </p>
        )}
        {Object.values(tournaments).map((tournament) => (
          <div
            key={tournament.id}
            className="rounded-lg bg-white p-4 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800"
          >
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {tournament.name}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              {tournament.type} - {tournament.format.type} ({tournament.format.overs}{' '}
              {t('matchSetup.overs')})
            </p>
            <p
              className={clsx('mt-1 font-semibold', {
                'text-green-600': tournament.status === 'completed',
                'text-orange-600': tournament.status === 'in-progress',
                'text-blue-600': tournament.status === 'scheduled',
              })}
            >
              Status: {tournament.status}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex space-x-2">
              <Button onClick={() => openTournamentDetails(tournament)} variant="primary" size="sm">
                {tournament.status === 'in-progress'
                  ? t('tournament.resumeTournament')
                  : t('generic.view')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${tournament.name}?`)) {
                    deleteTournament(tournament.id);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {t('generic.delete')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Create Tournament Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isCreateModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
        title={t('tournament.createTournament')}
        size="lg"
      >
        <Input
          label={t('tournament.tournamentName')}
          value={tournamentName}
          onChange={(e) => setTournamentName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('tournament.tournamentName')}
          error={error.includes('name') ? error : ''}
          className="mb-4"
        />

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('tournament.selectTeams')}
          </label>
          <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-gray-300 p-2 dark:border-gray-700">
            {allTeams.map((team) => (
              <div
                key={team.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-sm p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
              >
                <span>{team.name}</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selectedTeams.includes(team.id)}
                  onChange={() => handleToggleTeam(team.id)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
                />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {error.includes('teams') && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <Select
          label={t('tournament.format')}
          value={formatType}
          onChange={(e) => setFormatType(e.target.value as GameFormat)}
          options={Object.values(GameFormat).map((format) => ({
            value: format,
            label: format,
          }))}
        />
        {formatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.overs')}
              type="number"
              value={customOvers}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomOvers(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.wickets')}
              type="number"
              value={customWickets}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomWickets(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <Select
          label={t('tournament.type')}
          value={tournamentType}
          onChange={(e) => setTournamentType(e.target.value as TournamentType)}
          options={Object.values(TournamentType).map((type) => ({
            value: type,
            label: type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN ? t('tournament.roundRobin') : t('tournament.knockout'),
          }))}
        />

        {error && <p className="my-4 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}

        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}>
            {t('generic.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleCreateTournament}>
            {t('tournament.create')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Tournament Details Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isTournamentDetailModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(false)}
        title={selectedTournament?.name || t('tournament.title')}
        size="xl"
      >
        {selectedTournament && (
          <div>
            <p className="mb-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              Format: {selectedTournament.format.type} | Type: {selectedTournament.type}
            </p>

            <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between space-x-4">
                <Button
                    onClick={handleAutoPlayTournament}
                    disabled={isSimulating || selectedTournament.status === 'completed'}
                    isLoading={isSimulating}
                    variant="primary"
                    className="flex-1"
                >
                    {isSimulating ? t('generic.loading') : t('tournament.autoPlay')}
                </Button>
                {/* Find first unplayed match to allow watching live */}
                {selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed) && (
                    <Button
                        onClick={() => {
                            const nextMatch = selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed);
                            if (nextMatch) {
                                // Need to create a new match state for this if it doesn't exist
                                let matchStateToPlay = nextMatch.matchStateId ? getMatchById(nextMatch.matchStateId) : null;
                                if (!matchStateToPlay) {
                                  const team1 = getTeamById(nextMatch.team1Id);
                                  const team2 = getTeamById(nextMatch.team2Id);
                                  if (team1 && team2) {
                                    matchStateToPlay = initializeMatch(
                                      selectedTournament.format,
                                      team1,
                                      team2,
                                      Math.random() < 0.5, // Random toss for initial setup
                                      Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'BAT' : 'BOWL',
                                      { difficulty: Difficulty.MEDIUM, enableDiceAnimation: true, enableSoundEffects: true, enableExtras: false, theme: 'light' }
                                    );
                                    saveMatch(matchStateToPlay);
                                    nextMatch.matchStateId = matchStateToPlay.id;
                                    const updatedTourn = {...selectedTournament, matches: selectedTournament.matches.map(m => m.id === nextMatch.id ? nextMatch : m)};
                                    updateTournament(updatedTourn);
                                  }
                                }

                                if(matchStateToPlay) {
                                    navigate(`/match/${matchStateToPlay.id}`);
                                    setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(false); // Close modal
                                }
                            }
                        }}
                        disabled={isSimulating || selectedTournament.status === 'completed' || !selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed)}
                        variant="secondary"
                        className="flex-1"
                    >
                        {t('tournament.watchLive')}
                    </Button>
                )}
            </div>

            {selectedTournament.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN && (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">{t('tournament.table')}</h3>
                <TournamentTable standings={selectedTournament.standings} allTeams={allTeams} />
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedTournament.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && selectedTournament.bracket && (
                <div className="mt-4">
                    <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">{t('tournament.bracket')}</h3>
                    <TournamentBracket bracket={selectedTournament.bracket} allTeams={allTeams} />
                    {selectedTournament.status === 'completed' && selectedTournament.bracket.length > 0 && (
                        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xl font-bold text-green-600">
                            {t('tournament.winners')}: {getTeamName(selectedTournament.bracket[selectedTournament.bracket.length - 1][0])}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-6">
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">Matches</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                    {selectedTournament.matches.map(match => (
                        <div key={match.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-gray-100 p-3 dark:bg-gray-700">
                            <span>
                                {getTeamName(match.team1Id)} vs {getTeamName(match.team2Id)}
                                {match.result && <span className="ml-2 font-semibold"> - {match.result.message}</span>}
                            </span>
                            {match.isPlayed && match.matchStateId && (
                                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => navigate(`/scorecard/${match.matchStateId}`)}>
                                    {t('match.viewScorecard')}
                                </Button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TournamentPage;
```

**47. `src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`**
```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import SettingsForm from '../components/SettingsForm';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation';

const SettingsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { settings, setSettings } = useGame();
  const [localSettings, setLocalSettings] = useState(settings);

  const handleSave = () => {
    setSettings(localSettings);
    navigate('/'); // Go back to home after saving
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4 md:max-w-md">
      <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
          {t('settings.title')}
        </h1>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <SettingsForm settings={localSettings} onUpdate={setLocalSettings} onSave={handleSave} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsPage;
```

*   **Tests (`src/__tests__/` and `e2e/`):** Unit and E2E tests.

**48. `src/__tests__/gameEngine.test.ts`**
```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  initializeMatch,
  resolveBall,
  checkInningsEnd,
  transitionInnings,
  calculateMatchResult,
  simulateFullMatch,
} from '../utils/gameEngine';
import {
  MatchState,
  GameFormat,
  Team,
  TossDecision,
  MatchStage,
  MatchResultType,
  Difficulty,
  GameSettings,
  Player,
} from '../types';
import { DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS, OVERS_PER_OVER, MAX_WICKETS } from '../utils/constants';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// Mock player and team data for consistency
const mockPlayer = (id: string, name: string, battingOrder: number): Player => ({
  id: uuidv4(),
  name: name,
  avatar: undefined,
  runs: 0,
  balls: 0,
  wickets: 0,
  overs: 0,
  maidens: 0,
  isOut: false,
  battingOrder: battingOrder,
});

const mockTeam = (id: string, name: string, numPlayers: number = 11): Team => ({
  id: id,
  name: name,
  players: Array.from({ length: numPlayers }, (_, i) =>
    mockPlayer(uuidv4(), `${name} Player ${i + 1}`, i + 1),
  ),
});

const teamA = mockTeam('teamA-id', 'Team A');
const teamB = mockTeam('teamB-id', 'Team B');

const defaultSettings: GameSettings = {
  difficulty: Difficulty.EASY,
  enableDiceAnimation: false,
  enableSoundEffects: false,
  enableExtras: false,
  theme: 'light',
};

describe('gameEngine', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Reset mocks or setup before each test if necessary
  });

  describe('initializeMatch', () => {
    it('should initialize a T20 match correctly with user winning toss and batting', () => {
      const matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA, // User team
        teamB, // AI team
        true, // User wins toss
        TossDecision.BAT, // User bats
        defaultSettings,
      );

      expect(matchState.format.type).toBe(GameFormat.T20);
      expect(matchState.team1Id).toBe(teamA.id);
      expect(matchState.team2Id).toBe(teamB.id);
      expect(matchState.tossWinnerId).toBe(teamA.id);
      expect(matchState.tossDecision).toBe(TossDecision.BAT);
      expect(matchState.currentInnings).toBe(1);
      expect(matchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.FIRST_INNINGS);
      expect(matchState.isUserBatting).toBe(true);
      expect(matchState.isUserBowler).toBe(false);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings).length).toBe(1);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].teamId).toBe(teamA.id);
    });

    it('should initialize an ODI match correctly with AI winning toss and bowling', () => {
      const matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.ODI],
        teamA, // User team
        teamB, // AI team
        false, // AI wins toss
        null, // User decision not relevant
        { ...defaultSettings, difficulty: Difficulty.HARD }, // AI will try to bat first
      );

      expect(matchState.format.type).toBe(GameFormat.ODI);
      expect(matchState.tossWinnerId).toBe(teamB.id);
      expect(matchState.tossDecision).toBe(TossDecision.BAT); // AI bats first for HARD
      expect(matchState.isUserBatting).toBe(false);
      expect(matchState.isUserBowler).toBe(true);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].teamId).toBe(teamB.id);
    });
  });

  describe('resolveBall', () => {
    let matchState: MatchState;

    beforeEach(() => {
      matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        true,
        TossDecision.BAT,
        defaultSettings,
      );
    });

    it('should add runs if batsman and bowler rolls do not match', () => {
      const initialScore = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].score;
      const initialBalls = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].legalBalls;
      const batsmanRoll = 4;
      const bowlerRoll = 2;

      const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
        matchState,
        batsmanRoll,
        bowlerRoll,
        true,
      );
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(initialScore + batsmanRoll);
      expect(currentInnings.wickets).toBe(0);
      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(initialBalls + 1);
      expect(ballOutcome?.isWicket).toBe(false);
      expect(ballOutcome?.runsScored).toBe(batsmanRoll);
      expect(updatedMatchState.commentaryLog.length).toBeGreaterThan(matchState.commentaryLog.length);
    });

    it('should register a wicket if batsman and bowler rolls match', () => {
      const initialScore = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].score;
      const initialWickets = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].wickets;
      const initialBalls = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].legalBalls;
      const batsmanRoll = 3;
      const bowlerRoll = 3;

      const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
        matchState,
        batsmanRoll,
        bowlerRoll,
        true,
      );
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(initialScore); // No runs scored
      expect(currentInnings.wickets).toBe(initialWickets + 1);
      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(initialBalls + 1);
      expect(ballOutcome?.isWicket).toBe(true);
      expect(ballOutcome?.runsScored).toBe(0);
      expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).not.toBe(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId); // New batsman
      expect(currentInnings.fallOfWickets.length).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should swap strike for odd runs', () => {
        const initialBatsman = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId;
        const initialNonStriker = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].secondBatsmanId;

        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(matchState, 1, 2, true); // 1 run
        const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

        expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).toBe(initialNonStriker);
        expect(currentInnings.secondBatsmanId).toBe(initialBatsman);
    });

    it('should not swap strike for even runs', () => {
        const initialBatsman = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId;
        const initialNonStriker = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].secondBatsmanId;

        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(matchState, 2, 1, true); // 2 runs
        const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

        expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).toBe(initialBatsman);
        expect(currentInnings.secondBatsmanId).toBe(initialNonStriker);
    });

    it('should handle end of over and rotate bowler', () => {
      // Simulate 5 balls
      let currentState = matchState;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(currentState, 1, 2, true);
        currentState = updatedMatchState;
      }

      const initialBowler = Object.values(currentState.innings)[0].currentBowlerId;
      const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(currentState, 1, 2, true); // 6th ball
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls % OVERS_PER_OVER).toBe(0); // Over completed
      expect(currentInnings.currentBowlerId).not.toBe(initialBowler); // Bowler rotated
    });

    it('should count an extra (wide) and re-bowl without incrementing legal balls', () => {
        const settingsWithExtras = { ...defaultSettings, enableExtras: true };
        let state = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, settingsWithExtras);

        // Mock Math.random to force an extra
        const originalMathRandom = Math.random;
        Math.random = () => 0.01; // Force extra, then force wide
        let { updatedMatchState: stateAfterExtra, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(state, 1, 2, true);
        Math.random = originalMathRandom; // Restore Math.random

        const currentInnings = Object.values(stateAfterExtra.innings)[0];

        expect(ballOutcome?.isExtra).toBe(true);
        expect(ballOutcome?.extraType).toBe('WIDE');
        expect(currentInnings.extras).toBe(1);
        expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(1);
        expect(currentInnings.balls).toBe(1); // Total balls incremented
        expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(0); // Legal balls not incremented
        expect(stateAfterExtra.commentaryLog[stateAfterExtra.commentaryLog.length -1]).toContain('Wide!');

        // Now bowl a normal ball
        const { updatedMatchState: stateAfterNormalBall } = resolveBall(stateAfterExtra, 4, 2, true);
        const nextInnings = Object.values(stateAfterNormalBall.innings)[0];
        expect(nextInnings.legalBalls).toBe(1); // Legal ball now counted
        expect(nextInnings.balls).toBe(2); // Total balls is 2 (1 extra, 1 legal)
        expect(nextInnings.score).toBe(1 + 4); // Score is 1 (extra) + 4 (batsman roll)
    });
  });

  describe('checkInningsEnd', () => {
    let innings: any; // Using 'any' for simpler modification for test cases
    const format = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20];

    beforeEach(() => {
      innings = {
        score: 0,
        wickets: 0,
        legalBalls: 0,
      };
    });

    it('should return false if neither wickets nor overs limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = 5;
      innings.legalBalls = 10 * OVERS_PER_OVER; // 10 overs
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return true if wickets limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = MAX_WICKETS;
      innings.legalBalls = 5 * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return true if overs limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = 5;
      innings.legalBalls = format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return true if both limits are reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = MAX_WICKETS;
      innings.legalBalls = format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('transitionInnings', () => {
    let matchState: MatchState;

    beforeEach(() => {
      matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        true,
        TossDecision.BAT,
        defaultSettings,
      );
      // Simulate first innings completion
      const currentInningsId = Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0];
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].score = 150;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].wickets = 5;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].isCompleted = true; // Manually set for test
    });

    it('should transition to second innings and set target for 1-innings-per-side format', () => {
      const updatedMatchState = transitionInnings(matchState);

      expect(updatedMatchState.currentInnings).toBe(2);
      expect(updatedMatchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK);
      expect(updatedMatchState.target).toBe(151);
      expect(Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings).length).toBe(2);
      const secondInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[1];
      expect(secondInnings.teamId).toBe(teamB.id); // Team B should be batting now
      expect(updatedMatchState.isUserBatting).toBe(false); // User team (A) was batting
    });

    it('should transition to MATCH_OVER after second innings completion for 1-innings-per-side format', () => {
      let state = transitionInnings(matchState); // First innings to second
      const secondInningsId = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
      state.innings[secondInningsId].score = 100;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].wickets = 3;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].isCompleted = true;

      const finalMatchState = transitionInnings(state);

      expect(finalMatchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER);
      expect(finalMatchState.result).not.toBeNull();
      expect(finalMatchState.status).toBe('completed');
    });

    it('should transition to 3rd innings for TEST format after 2nd innings completion', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings);

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;

        let stateAfter1st = transitionInnings(testMatchState);
        expect(stateAfter1st.currentInnings).toBe(2); // Team B's 1st innings

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(stateAfter1st.innings)[1];
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;

        let stateAfter2nd = transitionInnings(stateAfter1st);
        expect(stateAfter2nd.currentInnings).toBe(3); // Team A's 2nd innings
        expect(Object.values(stateAfter2nd.innings).length).toBe(3);
        expect(Object.values(stateAfter2nd.innings)[2].teamId).toBe(teamA.id);
    });

    it('should transition to 4th innings for TEST format after 3rd innings completion', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings);

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;
        let state = transitionInnings(testMatchState);

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
        state.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        state.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 3rd innings (Team A)
        const innings3Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[2];
        state.innings[innings3Id].score = 100; // Team A sets a target
        state.innings[innings3Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings3Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        expect(state.currentInnings).toBe(4); // Team B's 2nd innings
        expect(Object.values(state.innings).length).toBe(4);
        expect(Object.values(state.innings)[3].teamId).toBe(teamB.id);
        // Target calculation for test match 4th innings: (T1_I1 + T1_I3) - T2_I2 + 1
        // (200 + 100) - 150 + 1 = 151
        expect(state.target).toBe(151);
    });

    it('should transition to MATCH_OVER after 4th innings completion for TEST format', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings);

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;
        let state = transitionInnings(testMatchState);

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
        state.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        state.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 3rd innings (Team A)
        const innings3Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[2];
        state.innings[innings3Id].score = 100;
        state.innings[innings3Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings3Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 4th innings (Team B)
        const innings4Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[3];
        state.innings[innings4Id].score = 150; // Team B scores 150, target was 151
        state.innings[innings4Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings4Id].isCompleted = true;
        state.target = 151; // Set target for the test

        let finalState = transitionInnings(state);
        expect(finalState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER);
        expect(finalState.result).not.toBeNull();
        expect(finalState.result?.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS); // Team A wins by 1 run (300-299)
        expect(finalState.status).toBe('completed');
    });
  });

  describe('calculateMatchResult', () => {
    // Helper to create a basic match state for result calculation
    const createCompletedMatchState = (
      team1Score: number,
      team2Score: number,
      format: GameFormat,
      battingFirstTeamId: string, // ID of the team that batted first
      team2Wickets?: number, // Wickets lost by team2 (for win by wickets)
      inningsPerSide: number = 1,
      inningsData?: { [id: string]: any }
    ): MatchState => {
      const matchFormat = { ...DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[format], inningsPerSide };
      const innings1Id = uuidv4();
      const innings2Id = uuidv4();
      const initialInnings: { [id: string]: any } = {
        [innings1Id]: {
          id: innings1Id,
          teamId: battingFirstTeamId,
          score: team1Score,
          wickets: MAX_WICKETS, // Assume all out or overs completed
          legalBalls: matchFormat.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER,
          isCompleted: true,
          history: [], individualScores: {}, bowlingStats: {}, extras: 0, battingOrder: [], currentBatsmanId: null, secondBatsmanId: null, currentBowlerId: null, fallOfWickets: []
        },
      };

      if (inningsPerSide === 1) {
          initialInnings[innings2Id] = {
              id: innings2Id,
              teamId: battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id,
              score: team2Score,
              wickets: team2Wickets !== undefined ? team2Wickets : MAX_WICKETS,
              legalBalls: matchFormat.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER,
              isCompleted: true,
              history: [], individualScores: {}, bowlingStats: {}, extras: 0, battingOrder: [], currentBatsmanId: null, secondBatsmanId: null, currentBowlerId: null, fallOfWickets: []
          };
      } else if (inningsPerSide === 2 && inningsData) {
        // For Test matches, need 4 innings
        const innings3Id = uuidv4();
        const innings4Id = uuidv4();

        initialInnings[innings2Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: innings2Id, teamId: (battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id), score: inningsData.team2_I1.score };
        initialInnings[innings3Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: innings3Id, teamId: battingFirstTeamId, score: inningsData.team1_I2.score };
        initialInnings[innings4Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: innings4Id, teamId: (battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id), score: inningsData.team2_I2.score, wickets: team2Wickets !== undefined ? team2Wickets : MAX_WICKETS };
      }

      return {
        id: uuidv4(),
        format: matchFormat,
        team1Id: teamA.id,
        team2Id: teamB.id,
        team1Players: teamA.players,
        team2Players: teamB.players,
        tossWinnerId: battingFirstTeamId,
        tossDecision: TossDecision.BAT,
        currentInnings: inningsPerSide === 1 ? 2 : 4,
        innings: initialInnings,
        is
