import React from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx'; // FIX #3: Added import

interface InputProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label?: string;
  error?: string;
}

const Input = React.forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
  ({ label, error, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const baseStyles =
      'block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white';
    const errorStyles = 'border-red-500 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500';

    return (
      <div className="mb-4">
        {label && (
          <label htmlFor={props.id} className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <input
          ref={ref}
          className={clsx(baseStyles, { [errorStyles]: error }, className)}
          {...props}
        />
        {error && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

Input.displayName = 'Input'; // Add display name for forwardRef
export default Input;

--- START FILE: src\components\ui\Modal.tsx ---

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import Button from './Button';
import { useTranslation } from '../../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
  showCloseButton?: boolean;
}

const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  footer,
  size = 'md',
  showCloseButton = true,
}) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Prevent scrolling background
    } else {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscape);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'max-w-sm',
    md: 'max-w-md',
    lg: 'max-w-lg',
    xl: 'max-w-xl',
  };

  return ReactDOM.createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black bg-opacity-50 p-4"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (modalRef.current && !modalRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        className={`relative w-full transform rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-xl transition-all dark:bg-darkBg ${sizeClasses[size]}`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{title}</h3>
          {showCloseButton && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label={t('generic.cancel')}
              className="hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-600"
            >
              <svg
                className="h-6 w-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                ></path>
              </svg>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">{children}</div>
        {footer && <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">{footer}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
};

export default Modal;

--- END FILE: src\components\ui\Modal.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\components\ui\Select.tsx ---

import React from 'react';
import clsx from 'clsx'; // FIX #3: Added import

interface SelectOption {
  value: string | number;
  label: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

interface SelectProps extends React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
  label?: string;
  options: SelectOption[];
  error?: string;
}

const Select = React.forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectProps>(
  ({ label, options, error, className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const baseStyles =
      'block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white';
    const errorStyles = 'border-red-500 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-red-500';

    return (
      <div className="mb-4">
        {label && (
          <label htmlFor={props.id} className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        <select
          ref={ref}
          className={clsx(baseStyles, { [errorStyles]: error }, className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {options.map((option) => (
            <option key={option.value} value={option.value} disabled={option.disabled}>
              {option.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {error && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  },
);

Select.displayName = 'Select';
export default Select;

--- START FILE: src\contexts\GameContext.tsx ---

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import {
  GameState,
  GameSettings,
  Difficulty,
  MatchState,
  Team,
  Tournament,
  DEFAULT_TEAM,
  GameFormat,
  TournamentType,
  MatchFormat, // Added for clarity, though already available via DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS
} from '../types';
import useLocalStorage from '../hooks/useLocalStorage';
import { DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS } from '../utils/constants';
import { generateRoundRobinMatches, generateKnockoutMatches } from '../utils/helpers';

interface GameContextType {
  gameState: GameState;
  settings: GameSettings;
  teams: Team[];
  currentMatch: MatchState | null;
  tournaments: Tournament[];
  savedMatches: { [id: string]: MatchState }; // FIX #5: Added savedMatches
  setSettings: (newSettings: GameSettings) => void;
  updateTeam: (team: Team) => void;
  addTeam: (team: Team) => void;
  deleteTeam: (teamId: string) => void;
  saveMatch: (matchState: MatchState) => void;
  loadMatch: (matchId: string) => MatchState | null;
  setCurrentMatch: (matchId: string | null) => void;
  deleteMatch: (matchId: string) => void;
  createTournament: (
    name: string,
    format: GameFormat,
    tournamentType: TournamentType,
    teamIds: string[],
    overs?: number,
    wickets?: number,
  ) => Tournament;
  updateTournament: (tournament: Tournament) => void;
  deleteTournament: (tournamentId: string) => void;
  getMatchById: (matchId: string) => MatchState | undefined;
  getTeamById: (teamId: string) => Team | undefined;
}

const GameContext = createContext<GameContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const initialSettings: GameSettings = {
  difficulty: Difficulty.MEDIUM,
  enableDiceAnimation: true,
  enableSoundEffects: true,
  enableExtras: false,
  theme: 'light',
};

// Initial state for localStorage
const initialGameState: GameState = {
  teams: [
    { ...DEFAULT_TEAM, id: uuidv4(), name: 'Player XI' },
    { ...DEFAULT_TEAM, id: uuidv4(), name: 'AI Knights' },
    { ...DEFAULT_TEAM, id: uuidv4(), name: 'AI Gladiators' },
    { ...DEFAULT_TEAM, id: uuidv4(), name: 'AI Dominators' },
  ],
  settings: initialSettings,
  currentMatchId: null,
  savedMatches: {},
  tournaments: {},
};

export const GameProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [persistedGameState, setPersistedGameState] = useLocalStorage<GameState>(
    'diceCricketGameState',
    initialGameState,
  );

  const [localSettings, setLocalSettings] = useState<GameSettings>(
    persistedGameState.settings || initialSettings,
  );

  // Update persisted settings if local settings change
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({ ...prev, settings: localSettings }));
  }, [localSettings, setPersistedGameState]);

  const updateTeam = useCallback(
    (team: Team) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        teams: prev.teams.map((t) => (t.id === team.id ? team : t)),
      }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const addTeam = useCallback(
    (team: Team) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        teams: [...prev.teams, team],
      }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const deleteTeam = useCallback(
    (teamId: string) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        teams: prev.teams.filter((t) => t.id !== teamId),
      }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const saveMatch = useCallback(
    (matchState: MatchState) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        savedMatches: {
          ...prev.savedMatches,
          [matchState.id]: { ...matchState, lastPlayedAt: Date.now() },
        },
        currentMatchId: matchState.status === 'active' ? matchState.id : null,
      }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const loadMatch = useCallback(
    (matchId: string): MatchState | null => {
      const match = persistedGameState.savedMatches[matchId];
      return match || null;
    },
    [persistedGameState.savedMatches],
  );

  const deleteMatch = useCallback(
    (matchId: string) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => {
        const newSavedMatches = { ...prev.savedMatches };
        delete newSavedMatches[matchId];
        return {
          ...prev,
          savedMatches: newSavedMatches,
          currentMatchId: prev.currentMatchId === matchId ? null : prev.currentMatchId,
        };
      });
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const setCurrentMatch = useCallback(
    (matchId: string | null) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({ ...prev, currentMatchId: matchId }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const getMatchById = useCallback(
    (matchId: string) => {
      return persistedGameState.savedMatches[matchId];
    },
    [persistedGameState.savedMatches],
  );

  const getTeamById = useCallback(
    (teamId: string) => {
      return persistedGameState.teams.find((t) => t.id === teamId);
    },
    [persistedGameState.teams],
  );

  const createTournament = useCallback(
    (
      name: string,
      formatType: GameFormat,
      tournamentType: TournamentType,
      teamIds: string[],
      overs?: number,
      wickets?: number,
    ): Tournament => {
      const id = uuidv4();
      const matchFormat: MatchFormat =
        formatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && overs && wickets
          ? { type: GameFormat.CUSTOM, overs, wickets, inningsPerSide: 1 } // Simplified for custom to 1 innings
          : DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[formatType];

      let matches;
      let bracket;
      if (tournamentType === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN) {
        matches = generateRoundRobinMatches(teamIds);
      } else {
        // Knockout
        const { generatedMatches, generatedBracket } = generateKnockoutMatches(teamIds);
        matches = generatedMatches;
        bracket = generatedBracket;
      }

      const newTournament: Tournament = {
        id,
        name,
        format: matchFormat,
        type: tournamentType,
        teamIds,
        matches,
        currentRound: 1,
        status: 'scheduled',
        standings: teamIds.map((teamId) => ({
          teamId,
          played: 0,
          won: 0,
          lost: 0,
          drawn: 0,
          points: 0,
          nrr: 0,
        })),
        bracket,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastPlayedAt: Date.now(),
      };

      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        tournaments: {
          ...prev.tournaments,
          [id]: newTournament,
        },
      }));
      return newTournament;
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const updateTournament = useCallback(
    (tournament: Tournament) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        tournaments: {
          ...prev.tournaments,
          [tournament.id]: { ...tournament, lastPlayedAt: Date.now() },
        },
      }));
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const deleteTournament = useCallback(
    (tournamentId: string) => {
      setPersistedGameState((prev) => {
        const newTournaments = { ...prev.tournaments };
        delete newTournaments[tournamentId];
        return { ...prev, tournaments: newTournaments };
      });
    },
    [setPersistedGameState],
  );

  const currentMatch = useMemo(
    () => (persistedGameState.currentMatchId ? persistedGameState.savedMatches[persistedGameState.currentMatchId] : null),
    [persistedGameState.currentMatchId, persistedGameState.savedMatches],
  );

  const memoizedValue = useMemo(
    () => ({
      gameState: persistedGameState,
      settings: localSettings,
      teams: persistedGameState.teams,
      currentMatch,
      tournaments: Object.values(persistedGameState.tournaments),
      savedMatches: persistedGameState.savedMatches, // FIX #5: Exposing savedMatches
      setSettings: setLocalSettings,
      updateTeam,
      addTeam,
      deleteTeam,
      saveMatch,
      loadMatch,
      setCurrentMatch,
      deleteMatch,
      createTournament,
      updateTournament,
      deleteTournament,
      getMatchById,
      getTeamById,
    }),
    [
      persistedGameState,
      localSettings,
      currentMatch,
      updateTeam,
      addTeam,
      deleteTeam,
      saveMatch,
      loadMatch,
      setCurrentMatch,
      deleteMatch,
      createTournament,
      updateTournament,
      deleteTournament,
      getMatchById,
      getTeamById,
    ],
  );

  return <GameContext.Provider value={memoizedValue}>{children}</GameContext.Provider>;
};

export const useGame = () => {
  const context = useContext(GameContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useGame must be used within a GameProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

--- END FILE: src\contexts\GameContext.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\hooks\useLocalStorage.ts ---

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

function useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T>>] {
  // State to store our value
  // Pass initial state function to useState so logic is only executed once
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState<T>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return initialValue;
    }
    try {
      // Get from local storage by key
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      // Parse stored json or if none return initialValue
      return item ? (JSON.parse(item) as T) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      // If error also return initialValue
      console.error(`Error reading localStorage key “${key}”:`, error);
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  // useEffect to update local storage when the state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(storedValue));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Error writing localStorage key “${key}”:`, error);
      }
    }
  }, [key, storedValue]);

  return [storedValue, setStoredValue];
}

export default useLocalStorage;


--- END FILE: src\hooks\useLocalStorage.ts ---

--- START FILE: src\hooks\useTranslation.ts ---

import React, { useContext, createContext } from 'react';
import en from '../i18n/en.json';

// Define a type for your translations.
type Translations = typeof en;

interface I18nContextType {
  // t function, accepting a key (string or a key from Translations type) and an optional fallback
  t: (key: keyof Translations | string, fallback?: string) => string;
}

// Create the context with a default value.
// This default 't' function ensures that if the context is consumed outside a provider,
// it still returns a string (the key or fallback), preventing runtime errors.
const I18nContext = createContext<I18nContextType>({
  t: (key: keyof Translations | string, fallback?: string) => fallback || key.toString(),
});

const currentTranslations: Translations = en; // Our loaded translation file

export const I18nProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // The 't' function implementation
  const t = (key: keyof Translations | string, fallback?: string): string => {
    const keys = key.split('.');
    let value: any = currentTranslations; // Start lookup from the base translations object

    for (const k of keys) {
      if (value && typeof value === 'object' && k in value) {
        value = value[k];
      } else {
        // If a key in the path is not found, return the fallback or the original key
        return fallback || key.toString();
      }
    }
    // Ensure the final value is a string, otherwise return fallback/key
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : fallback || key.toString();
  };

// Provide the 't' function to all children
  return React.createElement(I18nContext.Provider, { value: { t } }, children);
};

// Custom hook to consume the translation context
export const useTranslation = () => {
  const context = useContext(I18nContext);
  // With a default value in createContext, context will never be undefined here.
  // We can keep a check if stricter null-safety is desired for future-proofing,
  // but it's technically not needed with the current pattern.
  // For robustness, keeping the check can be safer if createContext's default is ever removed.
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTranslation must be used within an I18nProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

--- END FILE: src\hooks\useTranslation.ts ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\Home.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import { formatTime } from '../utils/helpers';
import { MatchState } from '../types'; // FIX #6: Import MatchState for type assertion

const Home: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { savedMatches, setCurrentMatch, deleteMatch } = useGame(); // FIX #5: Access savedMatches directly
  const [showContinueModal, setShowContinueModal] = React.useState(false);
  const [matchToDelete, setMatchToDelete] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showDeleteConfirm, setShowDeleteConfirm] = React.useState(false);

  const savedMatchesList = Object.values(savedMatches).sort((a: MatchState, b: MatchState) => b.lastPlayedAt - a.lastPlayedAt); // FIX #6: Type assertion
  const activeMatches = savedMatchesList.filter((m: MatchState) => m.status === 'active'); // FIX #6: Type assertion
  // const completedMatches = savedMatchesList.filter((m: MatchState) => m.status === 'completed'); // FIX #6: unused variable

  const handleContinueMatch = (matchId: string) => {
    setCurrentMatch(matchId);
    navigate(`/match/${matchId}`);
  };

  const handleDeleteMatch = (matchId: string) => {
    setMatchToDelete(matchId);
    setShowDeleteConfirm(true);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (matchToDelete) {
      deleteMatch(matchToDelete);
      setMatchToDelete(null);
      setShowDeleteConfirm(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-8 text-4xl font-extrabold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('home.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col space-y-4">
        <Link to="/match-setup">
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.newMatch')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        {activeMatches.length > 0 ? (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full" onClick={() => setShowContinueModal(true)}>
            {t('home.continueMatch')}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full" disabled>
            {t('home.noSavedMatch')}
          </Button>
        )}

        <Link to="/tournaments">
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.tournaments')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        <Link to="/team-editor">
          <Button variant="outline" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.teamEditor')}
          </Button>
        </Link>

        <Link to="/settings">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="lg" className="w-full">
            {t('home.settings')}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showContinueModal}
        onClose={() => setShowContinueModal(false)}
        title={t('home.continueMatch')}
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {activeMatches.map((match: MatchState) => ( // FIX #6: Type assertion
            <div
              key={match.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-gray-100 p-3 dark:bg-gray-700"
            >
              <div>
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {match?.team1Players[0]?.name || 'Team 1'} vs{' '}
                  {match?.team2Players[0]?.name || 'Team 2'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                  {match.format.type} | {t('generic.lastPlayed')}: {formatTime(Date.now() - match.lastPlayedAt)} ago
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex space-x-2">
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => handleContinueMatch(match.id)}>
                  {t('match.resume')}
                </Button>
                <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => handleDeleteMatch(match.id)}>
                  {t('generic.delete')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {activeMatches.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              {t('home.noSavedMatch')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showDeleteConfirm}
        onClose={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}
        title={t('generic.confirmDelete')}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowDeleteConfirm(false)}>
              {t('generic.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={confirmDelete}>
              {t('generic.delete')}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-center text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
          {t('generic.areYouSureDeleteMatch')}
        </p>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Home;

--- END FILE: src\pages\Home.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\MatchPage.tsx ---

import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  MatchState,
  MatchStage,
  Innings,
  BallOutcome,
  Team,
  DEFAULT_PLAYER, // Keep this, might be used in more complex scenarios or in templates
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { resolveBall, checkInningsEnd, transitionInnings, calculateMatchResult } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import { playSound } from '../utils/helpers';
import { SOUND_PATHS } from '../utils/constants';

import Scoreboard from '../components/Scoreboard';
import CommentaryPanel from '../components/CommentaryPanel';
import MatchControls from '../components/MatchControls';
import DiceRoll from '../components/DiceRoll';
import MatchSummaryModal from '../components/MatchSummaryModal';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path

const MatchPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { getMatchById, saveMatch, getTeamById, setCurrentMatch, settings } = useGame(); // FIX #6: deleteMatch not used

  const [matchState, setMatchState] = useState<MatchState | null>(null);
  const [team1, setTeam1] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [team2, setTeam2] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [isRolling, setIsRolling] = useState(false);
  const [batsmanDiceValue, setBatsmanDiceValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [bowlerDiceValue, setBowlerDiceValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [showMatchSummary, setShowMatchSummary] = useState(false);

  // useRef to hold match state and settings for async operations
  const matchStateRef = useRef<MatchState | null>(null);
  const settingsRef = useRef(settings);
  useEffect(() => {
    settingsRef.current = settings;
  }, [settings]);


  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      const loadedMatch = getMatchById(id);
      if (loadedMatch) {
        setMatchState(loadedMatch);
        matchStateRef.current = loadedMatch;
        const t1 = getTeamById(loadedMatch.team1Id);
        const t2 = getTeamById(loadedMatch.team2Id);
        setTeam1(t1 || null);
        setTeam2(t2 || null);
        setCurrentMatch(id); // Set this match as the active one
      } else {
        navigate('/'); // Redirect to home if match not found
      }
    }
  }, [id, getMatchById, navigate, getTeamById, setCurrentMatch]);

  // Autosave when matchState changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (matchState && matchState.status === 'active') {
      saveMatch(matchState);
    }
  }, [matchState, saveMatch]);

  const currentInnings: Innings | undefined = matchState
    ? matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[matchState.currentInnings - 1]]
    : undefined;

  // const isCurrentInningsOver = currentInnings ? checkInningsEnd(currentInnings, matchState!.format) : false; // FIX #6: unused variable
  const isMatchOver = matchState?.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;
  const isInningsBreak = matchState?.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK;

  const handleRollComplete = useCallback(
    (newMatchState: MatchState, outcome: BallOutcome | null) => {
      setIsRolling(false);
      setBatsmanDiceValue(outcome?.batsmanRoll || null);
      setBowlerDiceValue(outcome?.bowlerRoll || null);

      if (outcome?.isWicket) {
        playSound(SOUND_PATHS.wicket, settingsRef.current.enableSoundEffects);
      } else if (outcome?.runsScored && outcome.runsScored > 0) {
        playSound(SOUND_PATHS.runs, settingsRef.current.enableSoundEffects);
      } else if (outcome?.isExtra) {
        // Maybe a specific sound for extras
      }

      setMatchState(newMatchState);
      matchStateRef.current = newMatchState; // Update ref immediately

      // Check for match end condition after each ball (e.g. target chased)
      if (
        newMatchState.currentInnings === 2 &&
        newMatchState.target > 0 &&
        currentInnings &&
        currentInnings.score >= newMatchState.target
      ) {
        const finalState: MatchState = { // FIX: Explicitly type finalState
          ...newMatchState,
          currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
          result: calculateMatchResult(newMatchState),
          status: 'completed',
        };
        setMatchState(finalState);
        matchStateRef.current = finalState;
        saveMatch(finalState); // Save final state
        setShowMatchSummary(true);
        return;
      }

      // Check for innings end
      if (newMatchState.currentInnings <= newMatchState.format.inningsPerSide * 2) { // Allow for 2 or 4 innings
        const currentInningsAfterRoll =
          newMatchState.innings[Object.keys(newMatchState.innings)[newMatchState.currentInnings - 1]];
        if (checkInningsEnd(currentInningsAfterRoll, newMatchState.format)) {
          // If innings is over, transition to next state
          const transitionedState = transitionInnings(newMatchState);
          setMatchState(transitionedState);
          matchStateRef.current = transitionedState;
          if (transitionedState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
            saveMatch(transitionedState);
            setShowMatchSummary(true);
          }
        }
      } else {
        // If it was the last innings and it's over by wickets/overs, match is over
        const currentInningsAfterRoll =
            newMatchState.innings[Object.keys(newMatchState.innings)[newMatchState.currentInnings - 1]];
        if (checkInningsEnd(currentInningsAfterRoll, newMatchState.format)) {
            const finalState: MatchState = { // FIX: Explicitly type finalState
                ...newMatchState,
                currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
                result: calculateMatchResult(newMatchState),
                status: 'completed',
            };
            setMatchState(finalState);
            matchStateRef.current = finalState;
            saveMatch(finalState);
            setShowMatchSummary(true);
        }
      }
    },
    [saveMatch, settings.enableSoundEffects, settingsRef, currentInnings],
  );

  const handleDiceRoll = useCallback(
    (batsmanRoll?: number, bowlerRoll?: number) => {
      if (!matchStateRef.current || isRolling) return; // Use ref for latest state
      setIsRolling(true);
      setBatsmanDiceValue(null); // Clear dice values for animation
      setBowlerDiceValue(null);

      // Simulate network/delay for animation effect
      setTimeout(() => {
        const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
          matchStateRef.current!,
          batsmanRoll || null,
          bowlerRoll || null,
          true,
        );
        handleRollComplete(updatedMatchState, ballOutcome);
      }, settingsRef.current.enableDiceAnimation ? 500 : 0); // Delay only if animation is enabled
    },
    [isRolling, handleRollComplete, settingsRef],
  );

  const handleNextInnings = () => {
    if (matchState) {
      const transitionedState = transitionInnings(matchState);
      setMatchState(transitionedState);
      matchStateRef.current = transitionedState;
      if (transitionedState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
        saveMatch(transitionedState);
        setShowMatchSummary(true);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleViewScorecard = () => {
    if (matchState?.id) {
      navigate(`/scorecard/${matchState.id}`);
      setShowMatchSummary(false); // Close summary modal if open
    }
  };

  const handleQuitMatch = () => {
    if (matchState) {
      const finalState: MatchState = { ...matchState, status: 'paused', lastPlayedAt: Date.now() }; // FIX: Explicitly type finalState
      saveMatch(finalState);
      setCurrentMatch(null); // Clear current match reference
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  if (!matchState || !team1 || !team2 || !currentInnings) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" className="text-primary" />
        <p className="ml-4 text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{t('generic.loading')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const battingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team1 : team2;
  const bowlingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team2 : team1;

  // Determine if player is batting or bowling
  const isUserBatting = matchState.isUserBatting && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;
  const isUserBowler = matchState.isUserBowler && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK && matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;

  const showNextInningsButton = isInningsBreak;
  const showViewScorecardButton = isMatchOver;
  const showResumeButton =
    matchState.status === 'paused' &&
    matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK &&
    matchState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Scoreboard */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1">
          <Scoreboard matchState={matchState} team1={team1} team2={team2} />
        </div>

        {/* Dice & Controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-6 lg:col-span-1">
          <div className="flex space-x-8">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              <span className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {battingTeam.name}
              </span>
              <DiceRoll
                value={batsmanDiceValue}
                rolling={isRolling && (isUserBatting || !matchState.isUserBowler)} // AI rolls if user is not batting
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              <span className="mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {bowlingTeam.name}
              </span>
              <DiceRoll
                value={bowlerDiceValue}
                rolling={isRolling && (isUserBowler || !matchState.isUserBatting)} // AI rolls if user is not bowling
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <MatchControls
            isUserBatting={isUserBatting}
            isUserBowler={isUserBowler}
            onRoll={handleDiceRoll}
            onNextInnings={handleNextInnings}
            onViewScorecard={handleViewScorecard}
            onQuitMatch={handleQuitMatch}
            isRolling={isRolling}
            showNextInningsButton={showNextInningsButton}
            showViewScorecardButton={showViewScorecardButton}
            showResumeButton={showResumeButton}
          />

          {isMatchOver && (
            <div className="mt-4 text-center">
              <p className="mb-2 text-xl font-semibold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
                {t('match.matchOver')}
              </p>
              <Button onClick={() => setShowMatchSummary(true)} variant="primary">
                {t('match.viewScorecard')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Commentary */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1">
          <CommentaryPanel log={matchState.commentaryLog} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <MatchSummaryModal
        isOpen={showMatchSummary}
        onClose={() => setShowMatchSummary(false)}
        matchResult={matchState.result}
        matchState={matchState}
        team1={team1}
        team2={team2}
        onViewScorecard={handleViewScorecard}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchPage;

--- END FILE: src\pages\MatchPage.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\MatchSetup.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  GameFormat,
  TossDecision,
  MatchFormat,
  Team,
  Difficulty,
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import { DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS } from '../utils/constants';
import { initializeMatch } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Select from '../components/ui/Select';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import TeamCard from '../components/TeamCard';

const MatchSetup: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { teams, saveMatch, settings, setCurrentMatch } = useGame();

  const [selectedFormatType, setSelectedFormatType] = useState<GameFormat>(GameFormat.T20);
  const [customOvers, setCustomOvers] = useState<number>(5);
  const [customWickets, setCustomWickets] = useState<number>(5);
  const [userTeamId, setUserTeamId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiTeamId, setAiTeamId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [userWinsToss, setUserWinsToss] = useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);
  const [userTossDecision, setUserTossDecision] = useState<TossDecision | null>(null);
  const [enableExtras, setEnableExtras] = useState<boolean>(settings.enableExtras);
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState<Difficulty>(settings.difficulty);

  const [showTeamSelectModal, setShowTeamSelectModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectingFor, setSelectingFor] = useState<'user' | 'ai' | null>(null);

  const currentUserTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === userTeamId);
  const currentAiTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === aiTeamId);

  const handleStartMatch = () => {
    if (!userTeamId || !aiTeamId) {
      alert(t('matchSetup.selectTeams'));
      return;
    }

    const userTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === userTeamId);
    const aiTeam = teams.find((t) => t.id === aiTeamId);

    if (!userTeam || !aiTeam) {
      alert(t('generic.error'));
      return;
    }

    let matchFormat: MatchFormat;
    if (selectedFormatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM) {
      matchFormat = {
        type: GameFormat.CUSTOM,
        overs: customOvers,
        wickets: customWickets,
        inningsPerSide: 1, // Custom matches usually single innings for simplicity
      };
    } else {
      matchFormat = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[selectedFormatType];
    }

    // Determine actual toss outcome if not yet decided by user
    const finalUserWinsToss = userWinsToss === undefined ? Math.random() < 0.5 : userWinsToss;

    // AI's toss decision if AI wins toss
    const finalUserTossDecision = finalUserWinsToss && userTossDecision !== null ? userTossDecision : null;

    const initialMatchState = initializeMatch(
      matchFormat,
      userTeam,
      aiTeam,
      finalUserWinsToss,
      finalUserTossDecision,
      { ...settings, enableExtras, difficulty }, // Pass current settings to match
    );

    saveMatch(initialMatchState);
    setCurrentMatch(initialMatchState.id); // Set as current match
    navigate(`/match/${initialMatchState.id}`);
  };

  const handleSelectTeam = (team: Team) => {
    if (selectingFor === 'user') {
      setUserTeamId(team.id);
    } else if (selectingFor === 'ai') {
      setAiTeamId(team.id);
    }
    setShowTeamSelectModal(false);
    setSelectingFor(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4 md:max-w-xl">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('matchSetup.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800">
        <Select
          label={t('matchSetup.format')}
          value={selectedFormatType}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedFormatType(e.target.value as GameFormat)}
          options={Object.values(GameFormat).map((format) => ({
            value: format,
            label: format,
          }))}
        />

        {selectedFormatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.overs')}
              type="number"
              value={customOvers}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomOvers(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.wickets')}
              type="number"
              value={customWickets}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomWickets(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mb-4 flex space-x-4">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.yourTeam')}
            </p>
            {currentUserTeam ? (
              <div
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-2 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700 cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('user');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
              >
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentUserTeam.name}</span>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  {t('generic.change')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('user');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
                className="w-full"
              >
                {t('generic.select')} {t('teamEditor.team')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.aiTeam')}
            </p>
            {currentAiTeam ? (
              <div
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 p-2 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700 cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('ai');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
              >
                <span className="font-semibold">{currentAiTeam.name}</span>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  {t('generic.change')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectingFor('ai');
                  setShowTeamSelectModal(true);
                }}
                className="w-full"
              >
                {t('generic.select')} {t('teamEditor.team')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.toss')}
          </label>
          <div className="flex space-x-4">
            <Button
              variant={userWinsToss === true ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setUserWinsToss(true)}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              {t('matchSetup.userWins')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={userWinsToss === false ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setUserWinsToss(false)}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              {t('matchSetup.aiWins')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {userWinsToss !== undefined && userWinsToss && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {t('matchSetup.chooseBatBowl')}
            </label>
            <div className="flex space-x-4">
              <Button
                variant={userTossDecision === TossDecision.BAT ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setUserTossDecision(TossDecision.BAT)}
                className="flex-1"
              >
                {t('matchSetup.batFirst')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant={userTossDecision === TossDecision.BOWL ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setUserTossDecision(TossDecision.BOWL)}
                className="flex-1"
              >
                {t('matchSetup.bowlFirst')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.difficulty')}
          </label>
          <Select
            value={difficulty}
            onChange={(e) => setDifficulty(e.target.value as Difficulty)}
            options={[
              { value: Difficulty.EASY, label: t('matchSetup.easy') },
              { value: Difficulty.MEDIUM, label: t('matchSetup.medium') },
              { value: Difficulty.HARD, label: t('matchSetup.hard') },
            ]}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="extrasToggle" className="text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('matchSetup.enableExtras')}
          </label>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id="extrasToggle"
            checked={enableExtras}
            onChange={(e) => setEnableExtras(e.target.checked)}
            className="h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
          />
        </div>

        <Button
          onClick={handleStartMatch}
          variant="primary"
          size="lg"
          className="w-full"
          disabled={!userTeamId || !aiTeamId || (userWinsToss !== undefined && userWinsToss && !userTossDecision)}
        >
          {t('matchSetup.startMatch')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={showTeamSelectModal}
        onClose={() => setShowTeamSelectModal(false)}
        title={t('generic.select') + ' ' + (selectingFor === 'user' ? t('matchSetup.yourTeam') : t('matchSetup.aiTeam'))}
        size="lg"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          {teams.map((team) => (
            <TeamCard
              key={team.id}
              team={team}
              onSelect={handleSelectTeam}
              isSelected={
                (selectingFor === 'user' && team.id === userTeamId) ||
                (selectingFor === 'ai' && team.id === aiTeamId)
              }
            />
          ))}
          {teams.length === 0 && (
            <p className="col-span-2 text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              No teams available. Go to Team Editor to create one.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MatchSetup;

--- END FILE: src\pages\MatchSetup.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\ScorecardPage.tsx ---

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { MatchState, Team } from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import ScorecardDisplay from '../components/ScorecardDisplay';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path

const ScorecardPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { getMatchById, teams } = useGame();

  const [matchState, setMatchState] = useState<MatchState | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      const loadedMatch = getMatchById(id);
      if (loadedMatch) {
        setMatchState(loadedMatch);
      } else {
        navigate('/'); // Redirect to home if match not found
      }
    }
  }, [id, getMatchById, navigate]);

  if (!matchState) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" className="text-primary" />
        <p className="ml-4 text-lightText dark:text-darkText">{t('generic.loading')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const team1 = teams.find((t) => t.id === matchState.team1Id);
  const team2 = teams.find((t) => t.id === matchState.team2Id);

  if (!team1 || !team2) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center p-4">
        <p className="text-lg text-red-500">Error: Teams not found for this match.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="mt-4">
          {t('scorecard.goToHome')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const inningsArray = Object.values(matchState.innings);

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('scorecard.matchSummary')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-blue-600 p-4 text-white shadow-xl dark:from-gray-700 dark:to-gray-900">
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-2xl font-bold">
          {team1.name} vs {team2.name}
        </h2>
        {matchState.result && (
          <p className="text-xl font-semibold">{matchState.result.message}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-8">
        {inningsArray.map((innings) => (
          <ScorecardDisplay key={innings.id} innings={innings} matchState={matchState} allTeams={teams} />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 flex justify-end space-x-4">
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
          {t('scorecard.goToHome')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ScorecardPage;

--- END FILE: src\pages\ScorecardPage.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\SettingsPage.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import SettingsForm from '../components/SettingsForm';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path

const SettingsPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { settings, setSettings } = useGame();
  const [localSettings, setLocalSettings] = useState(settings);

  const handleSave = () => {
    setSettings(localSettings);
    navigate('/'); // Go back to home after saving
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4 md:max-w-md">
      <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
          {t('settings.title')}
        </h1>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <SettingsForm settings={localSettings} onUpdate={setLocalSettings} onSave={handleSave} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsPage;
