--- START FILE: src\pages\TeamEditorPage.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { Player, Team, DEFAULT_PLAYER } from '../types'; // FIX #8: Imported DEFAULT_PLAYER
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import TeamCard from '../components/TeamCard';
import PlayerEditor from '../components/PlayerEditor';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts'; // FIX #1: Correct import path
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

const TeamEditorPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { teams, addTeam, updateTeam, deleteTeam } = useGame();

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingTeam, setEditingTeam] = useState<Team | null>(null);
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState<string>('');
  const [players, setPlayers] = useState<Player[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const openEditor = (team: Team | null = null) => {
    if (team) {
      setEditingTeam(team);
      setTeamName(team.name);
      setPlayers([...team.players].sort((a,b) => a.battingOrder - b.battingOrder)); // Ensure sorted for editing
    } else {
      setEditingTeam(null);
      setTeamName('New Team');
      setPlayers(
        Array(11)
          .fill(null)
          .map((_, i) => ({ ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: uuidv4(), name: `Player ${i + 1}`, battingOrder: i + 1 })),
      );
    }
    setError('');
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePlayerUpdate = (updatedPlayer: Player) => {
    setPlayers((prev) =>
      prev.map((p) => (p.id === updatedPlayer.id ? updatedPlayer : p)),
    );
  };

  const handlePlayerRemove = (playerId: string) => {
    setPlayers((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== playerId));
  };

  const handleAddPlayer = () => {
    setPlayers((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: uuidv4(), name: `Player ${prev.length + 1}`, battingOrder: prev.length + 1 },
    ]);
  };

  const handleSaveTeam = () => {
    if (!teamName.trim()) {
      setError('Team name cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }
    if (players.length < 11) {
      setError(t('teamEditor.minPlayers'));
      return;
    }

    // Ensure batting orders are unique and sequential if desired, or just use as entered
    const sortedPlayers = [...players].sort((a, b) => a.battingOrder - b.battingOrder);
    const uniqueOrderCheck = new Set(sortedPlayers.map(p => p.battingOrder));
    if (uniqueOrderCheck.size !== sortedPlayers.length) {
      setError("Batting orders must be unique.");
      return;
    }

    const teamToSave: Team = {
      id: editingTeam?.id || uuidv4(),
      name: teamName,
      players: sortedPlayers,
    };

    if (editingTeam) {
      updateTeam(teamToSave);
    } else {
      addTeam(teamToSave);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteTeam = (teamId: string) => {
    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this team?')) {
      deleteTeam(teamId);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('teamEditor.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between">
        <Button onClick={() => openEditor()} variant="primary">
          {t('teamEditor.newTeam')}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {teams.map((team) => (
          <TeamCard key={team.id} team={team} onEdit={openEditor} />
        ))}
        {teams.length === 0 && (
          <p className="col-span-full text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            No teams created yet. Click "New Team" to get started!
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title={editingTeam ? `${t('generic.edit')} ${teamName}` : t('teamEditor.newTeam')}
        size="xl"
      >
        <Input
          label={t('teamEditor.teamName')}
          value={teamName}
          onChange={(e) => setTeamName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('teamEditor.teamName')}
          error={error.includes('name') ? error : ''}
          className="mb-4"
        />

        <div className="mb-4 flex justify-between items-center">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('teamEditor.player')}s</h3>
            <Button onClick={handleAddPlayer} variant="secondary" size="sm">
                {t('teamEditor.addPlayer')}
            </Button>
        </div>


        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 p-2 dark:border-gray-700">
          {players.map((player, index) => (
            <PlayerEditor
              key={player.id}
              player={player}
              onUpdate={handlePlayerUpdate}
              onRemove={handlePlayerRemove}
              index={index}
            />
          ))}
          {error.includes('players') && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">
          {editingTeam && (
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => handleDeleteTeam(editingTeam.id)}>
              {t('teamEditor.deleteTeam')}
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>
            {t('generic.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSaveTeam}>
            {t('teamEditor.saveTeam')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TeamEditorPage;

--- END FILE: src\pages\TeamEditorPage.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\pages\TournamentPage.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'; // FIX #11: Import uuidv4
import {
  Tournament,
  TournamentType,
  GameFormat,
  Team,
  Difficulty,
  MatchState,
  MatchStage,
  MatchResultType,
  TossDecision, // FIX #12: Import TossDecision
} from '../types';
import { useGame } from '../contexts/GameContext';
import Button from '../components/ui/Button';
import Input from '../components/ui/Input';
import Select from '../components/ui/Select';
import Modal from '../components/ui/Modal';
import { useTranslation } from '../hooks/useTranslation.ts';
import TournamentTable from '../components/TournamentTable';
import TournamentBracket from '../components/TournamentBracket';
import { simulateFullMatch, initializeMatch } from '../utils/gameEngine';
import { updateRoundRobinStandings } from '../utils/helpers';
import Spinner from '../components/ui/Spinner';
import clsx from 'clsx';

const TournamentPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const {
    tournaments,
    teams: allTeams,
    createTournament,
    updateTournament,
    deleteTournament,
    saveMatch,
    getMatchById,
    getTeamById,
  } = useGame();

  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tournamentName, setTournamentName] = useState('');
  const [selectedTeams, setSelectedTeams] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [formatType, setFormatType] = useState<GameFormat>(GameFormat.T20);
  const [tournamentType, setTournamentType] = useState<TournamentType>(TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN);
  const [customOvers, setCustomOvers] = useState(5);
  const [customWickets, setCustomWickets] = useState(5);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [selectedTournament, setSelectedTournament] = useState<Tournament | null>(null);
  const [isTournamentDetailModalOpen, setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState(false);

  const handleCreateTournament = () => {
    if (!tournamentName.trim()) {
      setError('Tournament name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (selectedTeams.length < 2) {
      setError('Please select at least 2 teams.');
      return;
    }
    if (formatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (customOvers < 1 || customWickets < 1)) {
      setError('Custom overs and wickets must be at least 1.');
      return;
    }

    createTournament(tournamentName, formatType, tournamentType, selectedTeams, customOvers, customWickets);
    setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
    resetForm();
  };

  const handleToggleTeam = (teamId: string) => {
    setSelectedTeams((prev) =>
      prev.includes(teamId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== teamId) : [...prev, teamId],
    );
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setTournamentName('');
    setSelectedTeams([]);
    setFormatType(GameFormat.T20);
    setTournamentType(TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN);
    setCustomOvers(5);
    setCustomWickets(5);
    setError('');
  };

  const openTournamentDetails = (tournament: Tournament) => {
    setSelectedTournament(tournament);
    setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleAutoPlayTournament = async () => {
    if (!selectedTournament) return;

    setIsSimulating(true);
    let currentTourn = { ...selectedTournament };
    currentTourn.status = 'in-progress';
    updateTournament(currentTourn); // Mark as in-progress

    const updatedMatches = [...currentTourn.matches];
    let updatedStandings: { [teamId: string]: any } = { ...currentTourn.standings.reduce((acc, stat) => ({...acc, [stat.teamId]: stat}), {}) };
    let currentBracket = currentTourn.bracket ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentTourn.bracket)) : undefined;

    for (let i = 0; i < updatedMatches.length; i++) {
      let match = { ...updatedMatches[i] };

      if (match.isPlayed) continue;

      // Handle BYE in knockout
      if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && (match.team1Id === 'BYE' || match.team2Id === 'BYE')) {
          const winnerId = match.team1Id === 'BYE' ? match.team2Id : match.team1Id;
          match.result = {
              type: MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS,
              winningTeamId: winnerId,
              losingTeamId: match.team1Id === 'BYE' ? match.team1Id : match.team2Id, // The bye team is the 'loser'
              message: `${getTeamName(winnerId)} gets a bye!`,
          };
          match.isPlayed = true;
          match.matchStateId = uuidv4(); // Dummy ID for bye
          updatedMatches[i] = match;

          // Update bracket for the next round winner
          if (currentBracket && match.round) {
            const nextRoundIndex = match.round; // Next round is +1 relative to current, or current_round_index + 1
            const matchSlotIndex = Math.floor((match.matchNumber!-1) / 2);
            if (currentBracket[nextRoundIndex] && currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex] && winnerId) {
              currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex] = winnerId;
            }
          }
          continue;
      }


      const team1 = getTeamById(match.team1Id);
      const team2 = getTeamById(match.team2Id);

      if (!team1 || !team2) {
          console.error(`Teams not found for match ${match.id}`);
          continue;
      }

      const initialMatchState = initializeMatch(
        currentTourn.format,
        team1,
        team2,
        Math.random() < 0.5, // Random toss winner for AI vs AI
        Math.random() < 0.5 ? TossDecision.BAT : TossDecision.BOWL,
        { difficulty: Difficulty.MEDIUM, enableDiceAnimation: false, enableSoundEffects: false, enableExtras: false, theme: 'light' } // Default settings for simulation
      );

      const finalMatchState = simulateFullMatch(initialMatchState, team1, team2);

      saveMatch(finalMatchState); // Save the simulated match

      match.matchStateId = finalMatchState.id;
      match.result = finalMatchState.result;
      match.isPlayed = true;
      updatedMatches[i] = match;

      if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN) {
        updatedStandings = updateRoundRobinStandings(
          currentTourn.teamIds,
          updatedStandings,
          match,
          team1,
          team2,
          finalMatchState,
        );
      } else if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && match.round) {
          // Update bracket for the next round winner
          if (currentBracket && match.result?.winningTeamId) {
            const nextRoundIndex = match.round;
            const matchSlotIndex = Math.floor((match.matchNumber!-1) / 2);
            if (currentBracket[nextRoundIndex] && currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex]) {
              currentBracket[nextRoundIndex][matchSlotIndex] = match.result.winningTeamId;
            }
          }
      }

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve as any, 50));
    }

    currentTourn.matches = updatedMatches;
    if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN) {
      currentTourn.standings = Object.values(updatedStandings);
    } else if (currentTourn.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT) {
        currentTourn.bracket = currentBracket;
        // Check if a winner has been determined in the last round
        if (currentBracket && currentBracket.length > 0 && currentBracket[currentBracket.length - 1].length === 1 && currentBracket[currentBracket.length - 1][0] !== 'TBD') {
            currentTourn.status = 'completed';
        }
    }
    if (currentTourn.status !== 'completed') {
        currentTourn.status = 'in-progress';
    }
    updateTournament(currentTourn);
    setIsSimulating(false);
  };

  const getTeamName = (teamId: string) => allTeams.find((t) => t.id === teamId)?.name || teamId;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-4">
      <h1 className="mb-6 text-3xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
        {t('tournament.title')}
      </h1>

      <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between">
        <Button onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)} variant="primary">
          {t('tournament.createTournament')}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')} variant="outline">
          {t('generic.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {Object.values(tournaments).length === 0 && (
          <p className="col-span-full text-center text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            {t('tournament.noTournaments')}
          </p>
        )}
        {Object.values(tournaments).map((tournament) => (
          <div
            key={tournament.id}
            className="rounded-lg bg-white p-4 shadow-md dark:bg-gray-800"
          >
            <h3 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
              {tournament.name}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              {tournament.type} - {tournament.format.type} ({tournament.format.overs}{' '}
              {t('matchSetup.overs')})
            </p>
            <p
              className={clsx('mt-1 font-semibold', {
                'text-green-600': tournament.status === 'completed',
                'text-orange-600': tournament.status === 'in-progress',
                'text-blue-600': tournament.status === 'scheduled',
              })}
            >
              Status: {tournament.status}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex space-x-2">
              <Button onClick={() => openTournamentDetails(tournament)} variant="primary" size="sm">
                {tournament.status === 'in-progress'
                  ? t('tournament.resumeTournament')
                  : t('generic.view')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${tournament.name}?`)) {
                    deleteTournament(tournament.id);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {t('generic.delete')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Create Tournament Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isCreateModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
        title={t('tournament.createTournament')}
        size="lg"
      >
        <Input
          label={t('tournament.tournamentName')}
          value={tournamentName}
          onChange={(e) => setTournamentName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('tournament.tournamentName')}
          error={error.includes('name') ? error : ''}
          className="mb-4"
        />

        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium text-lightText dark:text-darkText">
            {t('tournament.selectTeams')}
          </label>
          <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-gray-300 p-2 dark:border-gray-700">
            {allTeams.map((team) => (
              <div
                key={team.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-sm p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
              >
                <span>{team.name}</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selectedTeams.includes(team.id)}
                  onChange={() => handleToggleTeam(team.id)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-700"
                />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {error.includes('teams') && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <Select
          label={t('tournament.format')}
          value={formatType}
          onChange={(e) => setFormatType(e.target.value as GameFormat)}
          options={Object.values(GameFormat).map((format) => ({
            value: format,
            label: format,
          }))}
        />
        {formatType === GameFormat.CUSTOM && (
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.overs')}
              type="number"
              value={customOvers}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomOvers(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
            <Input
              label={t('matchSetup.wickets')}
              type="number"
              value={customWickets}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomWickets(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
              min="1"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <Select
          label={t('tournament.type')}
          value={tournamentType}
          onChange={(e) => setTournamentType(e.target.value as TournamentType)}
          options={Object.values(TournamentType).map((type) => ({
            value: type,
            label: type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN ? t('tournament.roundRobin') : t('tournament.knockout'),
          }))}
        />

        {error && <p className="my-4 text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>}

        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 dark:border-gray-700">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}>
            {t('generic.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleCreateTournament}>
            {t('tournament.create')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Tournament Details Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isTournamentDetailModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(false)}
        title={selectedTournament?.name || t('tournament.title')}
        size="xl"
      >
        {selectedTournament && (
          <div>
            <p className="mb-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
              Format: {selectedTournament.format.type} | Type: {selectedTournament.type}
            </p>

            <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between space-x-4">
                <Button
                    onClick={handleAutoPlayTournament}
                    disabled={isSimulating || selectedTournament.status === 'completed'}
                    isLoading={isSimulating}
                    variant="primary"
                    className="flex-1"
                >
                    {isSimulating ? t('generic.loading') : t('tournament.autoPlay')}
                </Button>
                {/* Find first unplayed match to allow watching live */}
                {selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed) && (
                    <Button
                        onClick={() => {
                            const nextMatch = selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed);
                            if (nextMatch && nextMatch.team1Id !== 'BYE' && nextMatch.team2Id !== 'BYE') {
                                let matchStateToPlay = nextMatch.matchStateId ? getMatchById(nextMatch.matchStateId) : null;
                                if (!matchStateToPlay) {
                                  const team1 = getTeamById(nextMatch.team1Id);
                                  const team2 = getTeamById(nextMatch.team2Id);
                                  if (team1 && team2) {
                                    matchStateToPlay = initializeMatch(
                                      selectedTournament.format,
                                      team1,
                                      team2,
                                      Math.random() < 0.5, // Random toss for initial setup
                                      Math.random() < 0.5 ? TossDecision.BAT : TossDecision.BOWL,
                                      { difficulty: Difficulty.MEDIUM, enableDiceAnimation: true, enableSoundEffects: true, enableExtras: false, theme: 'light' }
                                    );
                                    saveMatch(matchStateToPlay);
                                    nextMatch.matchStateId = matchStateToPlay.id;
                                    const updatedTourn = {...selectedTournament, matches: selectedTournament.matches.map(m => m.id === nextMatch.id ? nextMatch : m)};
                                    updateTournament(updatedTourn);
                                  }
                                }

                                if(matchStateToPlay) {
                                    navigate(`/match/${matchStateToPlay.id}`);
                                    setIsTournamentDetailModalOpen(false); // Close modal
                                }
                            } else {
                                alert("No valid match to watch live (either all played or next is a BYE). Please auto-play or create more teams.");
                            }
                        }}
                        disabled={isSimulating || selectedTournament.status === 'completed' || !selectedTournament.matches.find(m => !m.isPlayed)}
                        variant="secondary"
                        className="flex-1"
                    >
                        {t('tournament.watchLive')}
                    </Button>
                )}
            </div>

            {selectedTournament.type === TournamentType.ROUND_ROBIN && (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">{t('tournament.table')}</h3>
                <TournamentTable standings={selectedTournament.standings} allTeams={allTeams} />
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedTournament.type === TournamentType.KNOCKOUT && selectedTournament.bracket && (
                <div className="mt-4">
                    <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">{t('tournament.bracket')}</h3>
                    <TournamentBracket bracket={selectedTournament.bracket} allTeams={allTeams} />
                    {selectedTournament.status === 'completed' && selectedTournament.bracket.length > 0 && (
                        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xl font-bold text-green-600">
                            {t('tournament.winners')}: {getTeamName(selectedTournament.bracket[selectedTournament.bracket.length - 1][0])}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-6">
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">Matches</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                    {selectedTournament.matches.map(match => (
                        <div key={match.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-gray-100 p-3 dark:bg-gray-700">
                            <span>
                                {getTeamName(match.team1Id)} vs {getTeamName(match.team2Id)}
                                {match.result && <span className="ml-2 font-semibold"> - {match.result.message}</span>}
                            </span>
                            {match.isPlayed && match.matchStateId && (
                                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => navigate(`/scorecard/${match.matchStateId}`)}>
                                    {t('match.viewScorecard')}
                                </Button>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TournamentPage;

--- END FILE: src\pages\TournamentPage.tsx ---

--- START FILE: src\types\index.ts ---

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Enums ---
export enum GameFormat {
  T20 = 'T20',
  ODI = 'ODI',
  TEST = 'TEST', // Simulated by fixed overs/wickets for simplicity
  CUSTOM = 'CUSTOM',
}

export enum Difficulty {
  EASY = 'EASY',
  MEDIUM = 'MEDIUM',
  HARD = 'HARD',
}

export enum TossDecision {
  BAT = 'BAT',
  BOWL = 'BOWL',
}

export enum MatchStage {
  TOSS = 'TOSS',
  FIRST_INNINGS = 'FIRST_INNINGS',
  INNINGS_BREAK = 'INNINGS_BREAK',
  SECOND_INNINGS = 'SECOND_INNINGS',
  MATCH_OVER = 'MATCH_OVER',
}

export enum OutcomeType {
  WICKET = 'WICKET',
  RUNS = 'RUNS',
  WIDE = 'WIDE',
  NO_BALL = 'NO_BALL',
}

export enum TournamentType {
  ROUND_ROBIN = 'ROUND_ROBIN',
  KNOCKOUT = 'KNOCKOUT',
}

export enum MatchResultType {
  WIN_BY_RUNS = 'WIN_BY_RUNS',
  WIN_BY_WICKETS = 'WIN_BY_WICKETS',
  TIE = 'TIE',
  DRAW = 'DRAW', // Only applicable for Test matches that run out of time/balls
  NO_RESULT = 'NO_RESULT',
}

// --- Player & Team Types ---
export interface Player {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar?: string; // URL to avatar image
  runs: number;
  balls: number;
  wickets: number;
  overs: number; // For bowlers, in balls (e.g., 6 for 1 over)
  maidens: number; // For bowlers
  isOut: boolean;
  battingOrder: number;
  // Add other stats as needed
}

export interface Team {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  players: Player[];
  // Store default players or full roster here
}

// --- Match State Types ---
export interface BallOutcome {
  id: string;
  batsmanId: string;
  bowlerId: string;
  batsmanRoll: number;
  bowlerRoll: number;
  runsScored: number;
  isWicket: boolean;
  isExtra: boolean; // For wides/no-balls
  extraType?: 'WIDE' | 'NO_BALL';
  commentary: string;
}

export interface Innings {
  id: string;
  teamId: string;
  score: number;
  wickets: number;
  balls: number; // Total balls bowled in innings (includes extras, then re-bowled for legal balls)
  legalBalls: number; // Legal balls counted towards overs
  extras: number;
  battingOrder: string[]; // Player IDs in batting order
  currentBatsmanId: string | null;
  secondBatsmanId: string | null; // Non-striker
  currentBowlerId: string | null;
  fallOfWickets: { playerId: string; score: number; wicketNum: number; over: number }[];
  individualScores: { [playerId: string]: { runs: number; balls: number; fours: number; sixes: number; isOut: boolean; outText?: string } };
  bowlingStats: { [playerId: string]: { balls: number; maidens: number; wickets: number; runsConceded: number; extras: number } };
  history: BallOutcome[]; // History of each ball
  isCompleted: boolean;
}

export interface MatchFormat {
  type: GameFormat;
  overs: number;
  wickets: number;
  inningsPerSide: number; // 1 for T20/ODI, 2 for Test (simulated)
}

export interface MatchResult {
  type: MatchResultType;
  winningTeamId: string | null;
  losingTeamId: string | null;
  runsDifference?: number; // If win by runs
  wicketsRemaining?: number; // If win by wickets
  drawType?: 'TIE' | 'DRAW'; // Specific type for a tie or test draw
  message: string;
}

export interface MatchState {
  id: string;
  format: MatchFormat;
  team1Id: string;
  team2Id: string;
  team1Players: Player[]; // Snapshot of players at match start
  team2Players: Player[];
  tossWinnerId: string;
  tossDecision: TossDecision;
  currentInnings: number; // 1 or 2
  innings: { [inningsId: string]: Innings }; // Map of innings, keyed by innings ID
  isUserBatting: boolean; // True if user controls the batting team this innings
  isUserBowler: boolean; // True if user controls the bowling team this innings
  currentMatchStage: MatchStage;
  target: number; // Target for second innings
  settings: GameSettings; // Snapshot of settings for this match
  result: MatchResult | null;
  commentaryLog: string[];
  createdAt: number; // Timestamp for saving
  lastPlayedAt: number;
  status: 'active' | 'completed' | 'paused';
}

// --- Settings Type ---
export interface GameSettings {
  difficulty: Difficulty;
  enableDiceAnimation: boolean;
  enableSoundEffects: boolean;
  enableExtras: boolean;
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
}

// --- Tournament Types ---
export interface TournamentMatch {
  id: string;
  team1Id: string;
  team2Id: string;
  matchStateId: string | null; // Link to a saved MatchState if played
  result: MatchResult | null;
  isPlayed: boolean;
  round?: number; // For knockout
  matchNumber?: number; // For order
}

export interface TournamentTeamStats {
  teamId: string;
  played: number;
  won: number;
  lost: number;
  drawn: number;
  points: number;
  nrr: number; // Net Run Rate (simplified for dice cricket if desired, or just based on runs scored vs conceded)
}

export interface Tournament {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  format: MatchFormat;
  type: TournamentType;
  teamIds: string[];
  matches: TournamentMatch[];
  currentRound: number; // For knockout
  status: 'scheduled' | 'in-progress' | 'completed';
  standings: TournamentTeamStats[]; // For round robin
  bracket?: string[][]; // 2D array representing knockout bracket, team IDs or 'TBD'
  createdAt: number;
  lastPlayedAt: number;
}


// --- Global State ---
export interface GameState {
  teams: Team[];
  settings: GameSettings;
  currentMatchId: string | null;
  savedMatches: { [id: string]: MatchState };
  tournaments: { [id: string]: Tournament };
}

// --- Utility types for forms etc. ---
export type DeepPartial<T> = {
  [P in keyof T]?: DeepPartial<T[P]>;
};

// --- Initial Data Defaults ---
export const DEFAULT_PLAYER: Player = {
  id: uuidv4(),
  name: 'New Player',
  runs: 0,
  balls: 0,
  wickets: 0,
  overs: 0,
  maidens: 0,
  isOut: false,
  battingOrder: 0,
};

export const DEFAULT_TEAM: Team = {
  id: uuidv4(),
  name: 'My Team',
  players: Array(11)
    .fill(null)
    .map((_, i) => ({ ...DEFAULT_PLAYER, id: uuidv4(), name: `Player ${i + 1}`, battingOrder: i + 1 })),
};

--- START FILE: src\utils\ai.ts ---

import { Difficulty, MatchState } from '../types';
import { getRandomInt } from './helpers';
import { DICE_MIN_VALUE, DICE_MAX_VALUE, OVERS_PER_OVER } from './constants'; // FIX #14: Correct import path

/**
 * AI logic for deciding the bowler's roll.
 * The AI bowler tries to match the batsman's roll to get a wicket.
 * Difficulty influences the bias towards recent batsman tendencies.
 *
 * @param batsmanHistory An array of the batsman's recent scores (rolls) in the current innings.
 * @param difficulty The current AI difficulty setting.
 * @returns A number between DICE_MIN_VALUE and DICE_MAX_VALUE (1-6).
 */
export const decideBowlingRoll = (batsmanHistory: number[], difficulty: Difficulty): number => {
  // Base uniform probability for all dice outcomes
  const probabilities: { [key: number]: number } = {};
  for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
    probabilities[i] = 1 / DICE_MAX_VALUE;
  }

  let biasFactor = 0;
  let historyLength = 0;

  switch (difficulty) {
    case Difficulty.EASY:
      biasFactor = 0; // No bias for easy
      break;
    case Difficulty.MEDIUM:
      biasFactor = 0.05; // Moderate bias
      historyLength = 5; // Look at last 5 balls
      break;
    case Difficulty.HARD:
      biasFactor = 0.1; // Stronger bias
      historyLength = 10; // Look at last 10 balls
      break;
  }

  if (biasFactor > 0 && batsmanHistory.length > 0) {
    const recentHistory = batsmanHistory.slice(-historyLength);
    const rollCounts: { [key: number]: number } = {};
    recentHistory.forEach((roll) => {
      rollCounts[roll] = (rollCounts[roll] || 0) + 1;
    });

    // Find the most frequent roll in recent history
    let mostFrequentRoll: number | null = null;
    let maxCount = 0;
    for (const roll in rollCounts) {
      if (rollCounts[roll] > maxCount) {
        maxCount = rollCounts[roll];
        mostFrequentRoll = parseInt(roll);
      }
    }

    if (mostFrequentRoll !== null) {
      // Apply bias: increase probability for the most frequent roll
      probabilities[mostFrequentRoll] += biasFactor;

      // Redistribute the subtracted probability evenly among other rolls
      const remainingRolls = DICE_MAX_VALUE - 1;
      if (remainingRolls > 0) {
        const subtractedFromOthers = biasFactor / remainingRolls;
        for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
          if (i !== mostFrequentRoll) {
            probabilities[i] = Math.max(0, probabilities[i] - subtractedFromOthers);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Ensure probabilities sum to 1 (due to floating point inaccuracies, might need minor adjustment)
  const sum = Object.values(probabilities).reduce((acc, p) => acc + p, 0);
  if (sum !== 1 && sum > 0) {
    for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
      probabilities[i] /= sum;
    }
  }

  // Sample a roll based on the probabilities
  let cumulativeProbability = 0;
  const rand = Math.random();
  for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
    cumulativeProbability += probabilities[i];
    if (rand <= cumulativeProbability) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  // Fallback in case of rounding errors (should not happen with good probabilities)
  return getRandomInt(DICE_MIN_VALUE, DICE_MAX_VALUE);
};

/**
 * AI logic for deciding the batsman's roll.
 * The AI batsman tries to score higher runs.
 * Difficulty influences the bias towards higher values.
 *
 * @param state The current match state (can be used for contextual decisions, e.g., target chase)
 * @param difficulty The current AI difficulty setting.
 * @returns A number between DICE_MIN_VALUE and DICE_MAX_VALUE (1-6).
 */
export const decideBattingRoll = (state: MatchState, difficulty: Difficulty): number => {
  // Base uniform probability
  const probabilities: { [key: number]: number } = {};
  for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
    probabilities[i] = 1 / DICE_MAX_VALUE;
  }

  let biasFactor = 0;
  switch (difficulty) {
    case Difficulty.EASY:
      biasFactor = 0; // No bias for easy
      break;
    case Difficulty.MEDIUM:
      biasFactor = 0.03; // Moderate bias towards higher scores
      break;
    case Difficulty.HARD:
      biasFactor = 0.06; // Stronger bias towards higher scores
      break;
  }

  if (biasFactor > 0) {
    // Increase probability for 4, 5, 6
    const highScores = [4, 5, 6];
    const lowScores = [1, 2, 3];
    const biasPerHighScore = biasFactor / highScores.length;
    const decreasePerLowScore = biasFactor / lowScores.length;

    highScores.forEach((score) => {
      probabilities[score] += biasPerHighScore;
    });
    lowScores.forEach((score) => {
      probabilities[score] = Math.max(0, probabilities[score] - decreasePerLowScore);
    });
  }

  // Add a slight bias if target is close and few balls remaining (only for hard difficulty)
  if (difficulty === Difficulty.HARD && state.currentMatchStage === 'SECOND_INNINGS') {
    const currentInnings = state.innings[Object.keys(state.innings)[1]]; // Second innings
    const runsNeeded = state.target - currentInnings.score;
    const ballsRemaining = (state.format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER) - currentInnings.legalBalls;

    // Aggressive play if many runs needed with few balls
    if (runsNeeded > 0 && ballsRemaining <= 12 && runsNeeded / ballsRemaining > 1) { // e.g., 20 runs off 10 balls
        // Further increase probability for 5, 6
        const aggressiveBias = 0.05; // Additional small aggressive bias
        probabilities[5] = Math.min(1, probabilities[5] + aggressiveBias / 2);
        probabilities[6] = Math.min(1, probabilities[6] + aggressiveBias / 2);
        probabilities[1] = Math.max(0, probabilities[1] - aggressiveBias / 2);
        probabilities[2] = Math.max(0, probabilities[2] - aggressiveBias / 2);
    }
  }

  // Normalize probabilities in case of floating point inaccuracies
  const sum = Object.values(probabilities).reduce((acc, p) => acc + p, 0);
  if (sum !== 1 && sum > 0) {
    for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
      probabilities[i] /= sum;
    }
  }

  // Sample a roll based on the probabilities
  let cumulativeProbability = 0;
  const rand = Math.random();
  for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
    cumulativeProbability += probabilities[i];
    if (rand <= cumulativeProbability) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  // Fallback
  return getRandomInt(DICE_MIN_VALUE, DICE_MAX_VALUE);
};

import { GameFormat, MatchFormat } from '../types';

--- START FILE: src\utils\gameEngine.ts ---

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import {
  MatchState,
  Innings,
  BallOutcome,
  MatchResult,
  MatchResultType,
  MatchStage,
  TossDecision,
  Player,
  MatchFormat,
  GameSettings,
  OutcomeType,
  Team,
  DEFAULT_PLAYER,
  Difficulty, // FIX #9: Imported Difficulty
} from '../types';
import { DICE_MAX_VALUE, DICE_MIN_VALUE, OVERS_PER_OVER } from './constants';
import { generatePlayerBattingOrder, getNextBatsmanId, getNextBowlerId, getRandomInt } from './helpers';
import { decideBattingRoll, decideBowlingRoll } from './ai';

/**
 * Initializes a new match state.
 * @param format The format of the match (T20, ODI, TEST, CUSTOM).
 * @param userTeam The user's team.
 * @param aiTeam The AI's team.
 * @param userTossWinner True if user won the toss, false if AI won.
 * @param userTossDecision The user's decision (BAT/BOWL) if they won.
 * @param initialSettings Current game settings for the match.
 * @returns The initial MatchState object.
 */
export const initializeMatch = (
  format: MatchFormat,
  userTeam: Team, // User's team
  aiTeam: Team, // AI's team
  userTossWinner: boolean,
  userTossDecision: TossDecision | null, // Only relevant if userTossWinner is true
  initialSettings: GameSettings,
): MatchState => {
  const matchId = uuidv4();
  let tossWinnerId: string;
  let tossDecision: TossDecision;

  if (userTossWinner) {
    tossWinnerId = userTeam.id;
    tossDecision = userTossDecision!; // User explicitly chose
  } else {
    tossWinnerId = aiTeam.id;
    // AI's toss decision: usually bat first for higher difficulties, random for easy
    if (initialSettings.difficulty === Difficulty.EASY) {
      tossDecision = Math.random() < 0.5 ? TossDecision.BAT : TossDecision.BOWL;
    } else {
      tossDecision = TossDecision.BAT;
    }
  }

  const battingFirstTeam = tossDecision === TossDecision.BAT ? (tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? userTeam : aiTeam) : (tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? aiTeam : userTeam);
  const bowlingFirstTeam = tossDecision === TossDecision.BOWL ? (tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? userTeam : aiTeam) : (tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? aiTeam : userTeam);

  const inningsId = uuidv4();
  const initialInnings: Innings = {
    id: inningsId,
    teamId: battingFirstTeam.id,
    score: 0,
    wickets: 0,
    balls: 0,
    legalBalls: 0,
    extras: 0,
    battingOrder: generatePlayerBattingOrder(battingFirstTeam.players),
    currentBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(battingFirstTeam.players)[0],
    secondBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(battingFirstTeam.players)[1] || null,
    currentBowlerId: bowlingFirstTeam.players[0]?.id || null, // First bowler by default
    fallOfWickets: [],
    individualScores: {},
    bowlingStats: {},
    history: [],
    isCompleted: false,
  };

  const matchState: MatchState = {
    id: matchId,
    format,
    team1Id: userTeam.id, // User's team is always team1 in matchState
    team2Id: aiTeam.id,   // AI's team is always team2 in matchState
    team1Players: userTeam.players,
    team2Players: aiTeam.players,
    tossWinnerId,
    tossDecision,
    currentInnings: 1,
    innings: { [inningsId]: initialInnings },
    isUserBatting: battingFirstTeam.id === userTeam.id,
    isUserBowler: bowlingFirstTeam.id === userTeam.id,
    currentMatchStage: MatchStage.FIRST_INNINGS,
    target: 0,
    settings: initialSettings,
    result: null,
    commentaryLog: [],
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    lastPlayedAt: Date.now(),
    status: 'active',
  };

  matchState.commentaryLog.push(
    `Welcome to the match between ${userTeam.name} and ${aiTeam.name}!`,
  );
  matchState.commentaryLog.push(
    `${
      tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? userTeam.name : aiTeam.name
    } won the toss and chose to ${tossDecision === TossDecision.BAT ? 'bat' : 'bowl'}.`,
  );
  matchState.commentaryLog.push(
    `--- ${battingFirstTeam.name} Innings 1 Starts ---`,
  );
  matchState.commentaryLog.push(
    `${battingFirstTeam.players.find(p => p.id === initialInnings.currentBatsmanId)?.name} is on strike.`,
  );
  matchState.commentaryLog.push(
    `${bowlingFirstTeam.players.find(p => p.id === initialInnings.currentBowlerId)?.name} to bowl.`,
  );

  return matchState;
};

/**
 * Resolves a single ball delivery.
 * @param matchState The current state of the match.
 * @param batsmanRoll The dice roll of the batsman (1-6).
 * @param bowlerRoll The dice roll of the bowler (1-6).
 * @param isUserAction True if the user initiated the roll.
 * @returns An updated MatchState and the BallOutcome.
 */
export const resolveBall = (
  matchState: MatchState,
  userBatsmanRoll: number | null,
  userBowlerRoll: number | null,
  isUserAction: boolean, // Indicates if the roll was triggered by user (for batsman/bowler logic)
): { updatedMatchState: MatchState; ballOutcome: BallOutcome | null } => {
  const currentInningsIndex = Object.keys(matchState.innings).length - 1;
  const currentInningsId = Object.keys(matchState.innings)[currentInningsIndex];
  const currentInnings = { ...matchState.innings[currentInningsId] };

  // FIX #8: Use Team objects for type safety
  const userTeam = { id: matchState.team1Id, name: matchState.team1Players[0]?.name || 'User Team', players: matchState.team1Players };
  const aiTeam = { id: matchState.team2Id, name: matchState.team2Players[0]?.name || 'AI Team', players: matchState.team2Players };


  const battingTeamPlayers = currentInnings.teamId === userTeam.id ? userTeam.players : aiTeam.players;
  const bowlingTeamPlayers = currentInnings.teamId === userTeam.id ? aiTeam.players : userTeam.players;

  const currentBatsman = battingTeamPlayers.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBatsmanId);
  const currentBowler = bowlingTeamPlayers.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBowlerId);

  if (!currentBatsman || !currentBowler) {
    console.error('Current batsman or bowler not found.', currentBatsman, currentBowler);
    return { updatedMatchState: matchState, ballOutcome: null };
  }

  let batsmanRoll: number;
  let bowlerRoll: number;
  let runsScored = 0;
  let isWicket = false;
  let isExtra = false;
  let extraType: 'WIDE' | 'NO_BALL' | undefined;
  let commentary = '';

  const batsmanHistory = currentInnings.history
    .filter((b) => b.batsmanId === currentInnings.currentBatsmanId && !b.isExtra)
    .map((b) => b.batsmanRoll);

  // Determine rolls
  if (isUserAction) {
    // User is batting: user provides batsmanRoll, AI provides bowlerRoll
    // User is bowling: user provides bowlerRoll, AI provides batsmanRoll
    if (matchState.isUserBatting) {
      batsmanRoll = userBatsmanRoll!;
      bowlerRoll = decideBowlingRoll(batsmanHistory, matchState.settings.difficulty);
    } else {
      batsmanRoll = decideBattingRoll(matchState, matchState.settings.difficulty);
      bowlerRoll = userBowlerRoll!;
    }
  } else {
    // Both AI for tournament auto-play or if user is watching an AI match
    batsmanRoll = decideBattingRoll(matchState, matchState.settings.difficulty);
    bowlerRoll = decideBowlingRoll(batsmanHistory, matchState.settings.difficulty);
  }

  // --- Handle Extras (Wides/No-balls) ---
  if (matchState.settings.enableExtras && Math.random() < 0.05) {
    // 5% chance of an extra ball
    isExtra = true;
    extraType = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'WIDE' : 'NO_BALL'; // 50/50 wide or no-ball
    runsScored = 1;
    currentInnings.extras += 1;
    currentInnings.score += 1;
    currentInnings.balls += 1; // Counts towards total balls, but not legal balls for over
    commentary = `${extraType === 'WIDE' ? 'Wide!' : 'No-Ball!'} 1 extra run, ball re-bowled.`;
    matchState.commentaryLog.push(commentary);

    const ballOutcome: BallOutcome = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      batsmanId: currentInnings.currentBatsmanId!,
      bowlerId: currentInnings.currentBowlerId!,
      batsmanRoll: 0, // No specific roll for extra
      bowlerRoll: 0, // No specific roll for extra
      runsScored: 1,
      isWicket: false,
      isExtra: true,
      extraType: extraType,
      commentary,
    };
    currentInnings.history.push(ballOutcome);
    return {
      updatedMatchState: {
        ...matchState,
        innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings },
        commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog],
      },
      ballOutcome,
    }; // Re-bowl this ball
  }

  // --- Resolve normal ball (dice match or runs) ---
  currentInnings.legalBalls += 1;
  currentInnings.balls += 1; // Total balls increment for all non-re-bowled deliveries

  commentary += `${isUserAction && matchState.isUserBatting ? 'You' : 'AI'} rolled a ${batsmanRoll}. `;
  commentary += `${isUserAction && matchState.isUserBowler ? 'You' : 'AI'} rolled a ${bowlerRoll}. `;

  if (batsmanRoll === bowlerRoll) {
    isWicket = true;
    currentInnings.wickets += 1;
    commentary += `Wicket! ${currentBatsman.name} is out! (${batsmanRoll} matches ${bowlerRoll})`;

    // Update individual batsman score for out status
    currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id] = {
      ...(currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id] || {
        runs: 0,
        balls: 0,
        fours: 0,
        sixes: 0,
      }),
      isOut: true,
      outText: `b ${currentBowler.name}`, // Out by bowler
      runs: (currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id]?.runs || 0) + runsScored, // Add any runs if scored before out (not applicable here with match condition)
    };

    // Add to fall of wickets
    currentInnings.fallOfWickets.push({
      playerId: currentBatsman.id,
      score: currentInnings.score,
      wicketNum: currentInnings.wickets,
      over: currentInnings.legalBalls / OVERS_PER_OVER,
    });

    // Get next batsman
    const nextBatsmanId = getNextBatsmanId(currentInnings, battingTeamPlayers);
    if (nextBatsmanId) {
      currentInnings.currentBatsmanId = nextBatsmanId;
      if (currentInnings.wickets < battingTeamPlayers.length - 1) { // If not last wicket already, update non-striker
        // Keep previous non-striker if possible, else the next in order
        // const currentBatsmanIndex = currentInnings.battingOrder.indexOf(currentBatsman.id); // FIX #6: unused variable
        // const nextBatterIndex = currentInnings.battingOrder.indexOf(nextBatsmanId); // FIX #6: unused variable
        if (currentInnings.secondBatsmanId === currentBatsman.id) {
          // If the non-striker was out, find the next one
          currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = currentInnings.battingOrder[currentInnings.battingOrder.indexOf(nextBatsmanId) + 1] || null;
        } else if (currentInnings.currentBatsmanId === currentBatsman.id && currentInnings.secondBatsmanId) {
          // If striker was out, non-striker remains, new striker comes in
          // This logic might need refinement for accurate cricket rotation
        } else {
           // Simplistic rotation: new striker, and new non-striker is next in line
          currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = currentInnings.battingOrder[currentInnings.battingOrder.indexOf(nextBatsmanId) + 1] || null;
        }

        // Simplest: just ensure striker and non-striker are distinct and valid
        if (currentInnings.currentBatsmanId === currentInnings.secondBatsmanId) {
          currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = getNextBatsmanId(currentInnings, battingTeamPlayers.filter(p => p.id !== currentInnings.currentBatsmanId));
        }

      } else {
        currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = null; // No non-striker if it's the last wicket
      }
    } else {
      currentInnings.currentBatsmanId = null; // All out
      currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = null;
    }
  } else {
    // Batsman scores runs
    runsScored = batsmanRoll;
    currentInnings.score += runsScored;
    commentary += `${currentBatsman.name} scores ${runsScored} runs!`;

    // Update individual batsman score
    currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id] = {
      ...(currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id] || {
        runs: 0,
        balls: 0,
        fours: 0,
        sixes: 0,
        isOut: false,
      }),
      runs: (currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id]?.runs || 0) + runsScored,
      balls: (currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id]?.balls || 0) + 1,
      fours: (currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id]?.fours || 0) + (runsScored === 4 ? 1 : 0),
      sixes: (currentInnings.individualScores[currentBatsman.id]?.sixes || 0) + (runsScored === 6 ? 1 : 0),
    };

    // If runs are odd, batsmen change strike
    if (runsScored % 2 !== 0 && currentInnings.secondBatsmanId) {
      const temp = currentInnings.currentBatsmanId;
      currentInnings.currentBatsmanId = currentInnings.secondBatsmanId;
      currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = temp;
    }
  }

  // Update bowler stats
  currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id] = {
    ...(currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id] || {
      balls: 0,
      maidens: 0,
      wickets: 0,
      runsConceded: 0,
      extras: 0,
    }),
    balls: (currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id]?.balls || 0) + 1,
    wickets: (currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id]?.wickets || 0) + (isWicket ? 1 : 0),
    runsConceded: (currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id]?.runsConceded || 0) + runsScored,
    extras: (currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id]?.extras || 0) + (isExtra ? 1 : 0),
  };

  const ballOutcome: BallOutcome = {
    id: uuidv4(),
    batsmanId: currentBatsman.id,
    bowlerId: currentBowler.id,
    batsmanRoll,
    bowlerRoll,
    runsScored,
    isWicket,
    isExtra,
    extraType,
    commentary,
  };
  currentInnings.history.push(ballOutcome);
  matchState.commentaryLog.push(commentary);

  // Check for end of over and rotate bowler
  if (currentInnings.legalBalls > 0 && currentInnings.legalBalls % OVERS_PER_OVER === 0) {
    // End of over, rotate strike and bowler
    if (currentInnings.currentBatsmanId && currentInnings.secondBatsmanId) {
      // Swap striker and non-striker at end of over
      const temp = currentInnings.currentBatsmanId;
      currentInnings.currentBatsmanId = currentInnings.secondBatsmanId;
      currentInnings.secondBatsmanId = temp;
    }

    // Update maidens
    const lastOverBalls = currentInnings.history.slice(-OVERS_PER_OVER);
    const runsInLastOver = lastOverBalls.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.runsScored, 0);
    if (runsInLastOver === 0 && !lastOverBalls.some(b => b.isExtra)) {
      currentInnings.bowlingStats[currentBowler.id]!.maidens++;
    }

    const bowlingOrder = bowlingTeamPlayers.map((p) => p.id);
    const nextBowlerId = getNextBowlerId(currentInnings.currentBowlerId, bowlingOrder);
    if (nextBowlerId) {
      currentInnings.currentBowlerId = nextBowlerId;
      matchState.commentaryLog.push(
        `End of Over ${currentInnings.legalBalls / OVERS_PER_OVER}. Score: ${
          battingTeamPlayers[0].name
        } ${currentInnings.score}/${currentInnings.wickets}`,
      );
      matchState.commentaryLog.push(
        `${battingTeamPlayers.find(p => p.id === currentInnings.currentBatsmanId)?.name || 'Next Batsman'} is on strike. ${
          bowlingTeamPlayers.find(p => p.id === currentInnings.currentBowlerId)?.name || ''
        } to bowl.`,
      );
    }
  }


  // Update innings in match state
  const updatedInnings = { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings };

  return {
    updatedMatchState: {
      ...matchState,
      innings: updatedInnings,
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog],
    },
    ballOutcome,
  };
};

/**
 * Checks if the current innings has ended.
 * @param innings The current innings state.
 * @param format The match format.
 * @returns True if innings is over.
 */
export const checkInningsEnd = (innings: Innings, format: MatchFormat): boolean => {
  const allOut = innings.wickets >= format.wickets;
  const allOversBowled = innings.legalBalls >= format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
  const totalPlayersInBattingTeam = innings.battingOrder.length;
  // Innings also ends if all available batsmen are out (e.g., if there are only 5 players, 5 wickets means all out)
  const allPlayersBatted = innings.wickets >= totalPlayersInBattingTeam;

  return (allOut || allOversBowled) || allPlayersBatted;
};

/**
 * Transitions to the next innings or concludes the match.
 * @param matchState The current match state.
 * @returns An updated MatchState.
 */
export const transitionInnings = (matchState: MatchState): MatchState => {
  const currentInningsIndex = Object.keys(matchState.innings).length - 1;
  const currentInningsId = Object.keys(matchState.innings)[currentInningsIndex];
  const currentInnings = matchState.innings[currentInningsId];
  currentInnings.isCompleted = true; // Mark current innings as complete

  // FIX #8: Use explicit Team objects for type safety
  const userTeam: Team = { id: matchState.team1Id, name: matchState.team1Players[0]?.name || 'User Team', players: matchState.team1Players };
  const aiTeam: Team = { id: matchState.team2Id, name: matchState.team2Players[0]?.name || 'AI Team', players: matchState.team2Players };

  // If this was the first innings
  if (matchState.currentInnings === 1) {
    matchState.target = currentInnings.score + 1; // Target is 1 run more than first innings score
    const nextInningsId = uuidv4();

    // Determine who bats/bowls in second innings
    const battingFirstTeam = matchState.tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? userTeam : aiTeam;
    const bowlingFirstTeam = matchState.tossWinnerId === userTeam.id ? aiTeam : userTeam;

    const secondInningsBattingTeam = battingFirstTeam.id === currentInnings.teamId ? bowlingFirstTeam : battingFirstTeam;
    const secondInningsBowlingTeam = secondInningsBattingTeam.id === userTeam.id ? aiTeam : userTeam;

    const newInnings: Innings = {
      id: nextInningsId,
      teamId: secondInningsBattingTeam.id,
      score: 0,
      wickets: 0,
      balls: 0,
      legalBalls: 0,
      extras: 0,
      battingOrder: generatePlayerBattingOrder(secondInningsBattingTeam.players),
      currentBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(secondInningsBattingTeam.players)[0],
      secondBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(secondInningsBattingTeam.players)[1] || null,
      currentBowlerId: secondInningsBowlingTeam.players[0]?.id || null,
      fallOfWickets: [],
      individualScores: {},
      bowlingStats: {},
      history: [],
      isCompleted: false,
    };

    return {
      ...matchState,
      innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings, [nextInningsId]: newInnings },
      currentInnings: 2,
      currentMatchStage: MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK,
      isUserBatting: secondInningsBattingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      isUserBowler: secondInningsBowlingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog, `--- Innings Break ---`, `Target for ${secondInningsBattingTeam.name}: ${matchState.target} runs.`],
    };
  } else if (matchState.currentInnings === 2 && matchState.format.inningsPerSide === 1) {
    // Second innings of a 1-innings-per-side match (T20, ODI, custom)
    return {
      ...matchState,
      innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings },
      currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
      result: calculateMatchResult(matchState),
      status: 'completed',
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog, `--- Match Over ---`],
    };
  } else if (matchState.currentInnings === 2 && matchState.format.inningsPerSide === 2) {
    const nextInningsId = uuidv4();
    const thirdInningsBattingTeam = userTeam;
    const thirdInningsBowlingTeam = aiTeam;

    const newInnings: Innings = {
      id: nextInningsId,
      teamId: thirdInningsBattingTeam.id,
      score: 0,
      wickets: 0,
      balls: 0,
      legalBalls: 0,
      extras: 0,
      battingOrder: generatePlayerBattingOrder(thirdInningsBattingTeam.players),
      currentBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(thirdInningsBattingTeam.players)[0],
      secondBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(thirdInningsBattingTeam.players)[1] || null,
      currentBowlerId: thirdInningsBowlingTeam.players[0]?.id || null,
      fallOfWickets: [],
      individualScores: {},
      bowlingStats: {},
      history: [],
      isCompleted: false,
    };

    return {
      ...matchState,
      innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings, [nextInningsId]: newInnings },
      currentInnings: 3,
      currentMatchStage: MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK,
      isUserBatting: thirdInningsBattingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      isUserBowler: thirdInningsBowlingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog, `--- Innings Break ---`, `--- ${thirdInningsBattingTeam.name} Innings 3 Starts ---`],
    };
  } else if (matchState.currentInnings === 3 && matchState.format.inningsPerSide === 2) {
    const nextInningsId = uuidv4();
    const fourthInningsBattingTeam = aiTeam;
    const fourthInningsBowlingTeam = userTeam;

    const innings1 = matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]]; // UserTeam's 1st innings
    const innings2 = matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[1]]; // AITeam's 1st innings
    const innings3 = matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[2]]; // UserTeam's 2nd innings

    const team1Total = innings1.score + innings3.score;
    const team2Total = innings2.score;
    matchState.target = (team1Total - team2Total) + 1; // AITeam needs this to win

    const newInnings: Innings = {
      id: nextInningsId,
      teamId: fourthInningsBattingTeam.id,
      score: 0,
      wickets: 0,
      balls: 0,
      legalBalls: 0,
      extras: 0,
      battingOrder: generatePlayerBattingOrder(fourthInningsBattingTeam.players),
      currentBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(fourthInningsBattingTeam.players)[0],
      secondBatsmanId: generatePlayerBattingOrder(fourthInningsBattingTeam.players)[1] || null,
      currentBowlerId: fourthInningsBowlingTeam.players[0]?.id || null,
      fallOfWickets: [],
      individualScores: {},
      bowlingStats: {},
      history: [],
      isCompleted: false,
    };

    return {
      ...matchState,
      innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings, [nextInningsId]: newInnings },
      currentInnings: 4,
      currentMatchStage: MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK,
      isUserBatting: fourthInningsBattingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      isUserBowler: fourthInningsBowlingTeam.id === userTeam.id,
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog, `--- Innings Break ---`, `Target for ${fourthInningsBattingTeam.name}: ${matchState.target} runs.`],
    };
  } else if (matchState.currentInnings === 4 && matchState.format.inningsPerSide === 2) {
    return {
      ...matchState,
      innings: { ...matchState.innings, [currentInningsId]: currentInnings },
      currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
      result: calculateMatchResult(matchState),
      status: 'completed',
      commentaryLog: [...matchState.commentaryLog, `--- Match Over ---`],
    };
  }

  return matchState;
};

/**
 * Calculates the final result of the match.
 * @param matchState The completed match state.
 * @returns A MatchResult object.
 */
export const calculateMatchResult = (matchState: MatchState): MatchResult => {
  const inningsKeys = Object.keys(matchState.innings);
  const lastInnings = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[inningsKeys.length - 1]];
  const firstInnings = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[0]];

  const userTeamName = matchState.team1Players[0]?.name.split(' ')[0] || 'User Team'; // FIX #8: Use optional chaining
  const aiTeamName = matchState.team2Players[0]?.name.split(' ')[0] || 'AI Team'; // FIX #8: Use optional chaining

  let team1ScoreTotal = 0; // User Team's score
  let team2ScoreTotal = 0; // AI Team's score

  if (matchState.format.inningsPerSide === 1) {
    const team1BattingFirst = firstInnings.teamId === matchState.team1Id;
    const firstInningsScore = firstInnings.score;
    const secondInningsScore = lastInnings.score;

    if (team1BattingFirst) {
      team1ScoreTotal = firstInningsScore;
      team2ScoreTotal = secondInningsScore;
    } else {
      team2ScoreTotal = firstInningsScore;
      team1ScoreTotal = secondInningsScore;
    }

    if (team2ScoreTotal > team1ScoreTotal) {
      return {
        type: MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS,
        winningTeamId: lastInnings.teamId,
        losingTeamId: firstInnings.teamId,
        wicketsRemaining: matchState.format.wickets - lastInnings.wickets,
        message: `${(lastInnings.teamId === matchState.team1Id ? userTeamName : aiTeamName)} wins by ${
          matchState.format.wickets - lastInnings.wickets
        } wickets!`,
      };
    } else if (team1ScoreTotal > team2ScoreTotal) {
      return {
        type: MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS,
        winningTeamId: firstInnings.teamId,
        losingTeamId: lastInnings.teamId,
        runsDifference: team1ScoreTotal - team2ScoreTotal,
        message: `${(firstInnings.teamId === matchState.team1Id ? userTeamName : aiTeamName)} wins by ${
          team1ScoreTotal - team2ScoreTotal
        } runs!`,
      };
    } else {
      return {
        type: MatchResultType.TIE,
        winningTeamId: null,
        losingTeamId: null,
        message: "It's a tie!",
      };
    }
  } else {
    const innings1 = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[0]];
    const innings2 = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[1]];
    const innings3 = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[2]];
    const innings4 = matchState.innings[inningsKeys[3]];

    const team1OverallScore = innings1.score + innings3.score;
    const team2OverallScore = innings2.score + innings4.score;

    if (innings4.isCompleted) {
      if (team2OverallScore > team1OverallScore) {
        return {
          type: MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS,
          winningTeamId: innings4.teamId,
          losingTeamId: innings1.teamId,
          wicketsRemaining: matchState.format.wickets - innings4.wickets,
          message: `${(innings4.teamId === matchState.team1Id ? userTeamName : aiTeamName)} wins by ${
            matchState.format.wickets - innings4.wickets
          } wickets!`,
        };
      } else if (team1OverallScore > team2OverallScore) {
        return {
          type: MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS,
          winningTeamId: innings1.teamId,
          losingTeamId: innings4.teamId,
          runsDifference: team1OverallScore - team2OverallScore,
          message: `${(innings1.teamId === matchState.team1Id ? userTeamName : aiTeamName)} wins by ${
            team1OverallScore - team2OverallScore
          } runs!`,
        };
      } else {
        return {
          type: MatchResultType.DRAW,
          winningTeamId: null,
          losingTeamId: null,
          message: "It's a draw!",
        };
      }
    } else {
      return {
        type: MatchResultType.DRAW,
        winningTeamId: null,
        losingTeamId: null,
        message: "Match drawn (4th innings not completed).",
      };
    }
  }
};


/**
 * Simulates a full match between two AI teams or for tournament auto-play.
 * @param matchState The initial match state.
 * @param team1 The full object of team1.
 * @param team2 The full object of team2.
 * @returns The final match state.
 */
export const simulateFullMatch = (matchState: MatchState, team1: Team, team2: Team): MatchState => {
  let currentSimState: MatchState = { ...matchState };
  currentSimState.status = 'active';

  const getTeam = (id: string) => (id === team1.id ? team1 : team2);

  while (currentSimState.currentMatchStage !== MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
    const currentInningsIndex = Object.keys(currentSimState.innings).length - 1;
    const currentInningsId = Object.keys(currentSimState.innings)[currentInningsIndex];
    const currentInnings = currentSimState.innings[currentInningsId];

    if (currentSimState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK) {
      currentSimState = transitionInnings(currentSimState);
      // After transitionInnings, the matchStage could be FIRST_INNINGS, SECOND_INNINGS, or MATCH_OVER
      // No need to manually set currentMatchStage here as transitionInnings already handles it.
      if (currentSimState.currentMatchStage === MatchStage.MATCH_OVER) {
          currentSimState = { ...currentSimState, result: calculateMatchResult(currentSimState), status: 'completed' };
      }
      continue;
    }

    const battingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team1 : team2;
    const bowlingTeam = currentInnings.teamId === team1.id ? team2 : team1;

    // Check if innings ended
    if (checkInningsEnd(currentInnings, currentSimState.format) || (currentSimState.currentInnings === 2 && currentInnings.score >= currentSimState.target)) { // Also check target chase mid-innings
        currentSimState = transitionInnings(currentSimState);
        continue;
    }

    const currentBatsman = currentInnings.currentBatsmanId
      ? battingTeam.players.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBatsmanId)
      : null;
    const currentBowler = currentInnings.currentBowlerId
      ? bowlingTeam.players.find((p) => p.id === currentInnings.currentBowlerId)
      : null;

    if (!currentBatsman || !currentBowler) {
        currentSimState = transitionInnings(currentSimState);
        continue;
    }

    const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(currentSimState, null, null, false);
    currentSimState = updatedMatchState;

    if (currentSimState.currentInnings === 2 && currentSimState.target > 0) {
        const currentSecondInnings = currentSimState.innings[Object.keys(currentSimState.innings)[1]];
        if (currentSecondInnings.score >= currentSimState.target) {
            currentSimState = {
                ...currentSimState,
                currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER,
                result: calculateMatchResult(currentSimState),
                status: 'completed',
                commentaryLog: [...currentSimState.commentaryLog, `Target reached! ${getTeam(currentSecondInnings.teamId).name} wins!`],
            };
        }
    }
  }

  currentSimState.status = 'completed';
  return currentSimState;
};

import {
  Player,
  Team,
  Innings,
  BallOutcome, // FIX #6: Not used, removed
  MatchResult, // FIX #6: Not used, removed
  MatchResultType,
  TournamentMatch,
  MatchState,
  TournamentTeamStats,
} from '../types';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export const getRandomInt = (min: number, max: number): number => {
  min = Math.ceil(min);
  max = Math.floor(max);
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
};

export const getPlayerName = (team: Team | undefined, playerId: string): string => {
  return team?.players.find((p) => p.id === playerId)?.name || 'Unknown Player';
};

export const formatOvers = (legalBalls: number): string => { // FIX #6: Removed totalBalls as it's not used
  const completedOvers = Math.floor(legalBalls / 6);
  const ballsInCurrentOver = legalBalls % 6;
  return `${completedOvers}.${ballsInCurrentOver}`;
};

export const calculateStrikeRate = (runs: number, balls: number): string => {
  if (balls === 0) return '0.00';
  return ((runs / balls) * 100).toFixed(2);
};

export const calculateEconomy = (runsConceded: number, ballsBowled: number): string => {
  if (ballsBowled === 0) return '0.00';
  const oversBowled = Math.floor(ballsBowled / 6) + (ballsBowled % 6) / 10; // Simple way to get X.Y overs
  if (oversBowled === 0) return '0.00';
  return (runsConceded / oversBowled).toFixed(2);
};

export const getRunsEmoji = (runs: number): string => {
  switch (runs) {
    case 1:
      return '🏃';
    case 2:
      return '🏃🏃';
    case 3:
      return '🏃🏃🏃';
    case 4:
      return ' Boundaries! 💥';
    case 5:
      return ' Powerful!';
    case 6:
      return ' Six! 🚀';
    default:
      return '';
  }
};

export const generatePlayerBattingOrder = (players: Player[]): string[] => {
  // Sort players by their battingOrder property
  return players
    .sort((a, b) => a.battingOrder - b.battingOrder)
    .map((player) => player.id);
};

export const generatePlayerBowlingOrder = (players: Player[]): string[] => {
  // For simplicity, just use batting order in reverse or a random order for AI
  // In a real game, bowlers would be distinct from batsmen.
  // Here, any player can bowl. Let's just use the batting order for now.
  return players.map((player) => player.id);
};

export const getNextBatsmanId = (
  innings: Innings,
  teamPlayers: Player[],
): string | null => {
  const battedPlayers = Object.keys(innings.individualScores);
  const remainingBatsmen = innings.battingOrder.filter(
    (playerId) => !battedPlayers.includes(playerId),
  );

  if (remainingBatsmen.length > 0) {
    return remainingBatsmen[0];
  }

  return null; // All players have batted
};

export const getNextBowlerId = (
  currentBowlerId: string | null,
  bowlingOrder: string[],
): string | null => {
  if (bowlingOrder.length === 0) return null;

  if (!currentBowlerId) {
    return bowlingOrder[0]; // First bowler
  }

  const currentIndex = bowlingOrder.indexOf(currentBowlerId);
  const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % bowlingOrder.length;
  return bowlingOrder[nextIndex];
};

export const playSound = (path: string, enabled: boolean) => {
  if (enabled) {
    const audio = new Audio(path);
    audio.play().catch((e) => console.warn('Could not play sound:', e.message));
  }
};

export const formatTime = (ms: number) => {
  const seconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);

  const pad = (num: number) => String(num).padStart(2, '0');

  if (hours > 0) {
    return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes % 60)}:${pad(seconds % 60)}`;
  } else if (minutes > 0) {
    return `${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds % 60)}`;
  } else {
    return `${pad(seconds)}`;
  }
};

// --- Tournament Helpers ---

/**
 * Generates a list of matches for a round-robin tournament.
 * Each team plays every other team once.
 */
export const generateRoundRobinMatches = (teamIds: string[]): TournamentMatch[] => {
  const matches: TournamentMatch[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < teamIds.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < teamIds.length; j++) {
      matches.push({
        id: uuidv4(),
        team1Id: teamIds[i],
        team2Id: teamIds[j],
        matchStateId: null,
        result: null,
        isPlayed: false,
      });
    }
  }
  return matches;
};

/**
 * Generates a list of matches and a bracket structure for a knockout tournament.
 * Ensures the number of teams is a power of 2 by adding 'BYE's if necessary.
 */
export const generateKnockoutMatches = (
  teamIds: string[],
): { generatedMatches: TournamentMatch[]; generatedBracket: string[][] } => {
  const numTeams = teamIds.length;
  let nextPowerOf2 = 1;
  while (nextPowerOf2 < numTeams) {
    nextPowerOf2 *= 2;
  }

  const teamsForBracket = [...teamIds];
  // Add BYE teams if not a power of 2
  while (teamsForBracket.length < nextPowerOf2) {
    teamsForBracket.push('BYE'); // Placeholder for a bye
  }

  // Shuffle teams for initial seeding, or implement a proper seeding algorithm
  teamsForBracket.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

  const bracket: string[][] = [];
  let currentRoundTeams = [...teamsForBracket];
  let roundNum = 1;
  const generatedMatches: TournamentMatch[] = [];

  while (currentRoundTeams.length > 1) {
    bracket.push([...currentRoundTeams]); // Store teams for this round
    const nextRoundTeams: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < currentRoundTeams.length; i += 2) {
      const team1Id = currentRoundTeams[i];
      const team2Id = currentRoundTeams[i + 1];

      // Handle BYEs
      if (team1Id === 'BYE') {
        nextRoundTeams.push(team2Id); // Team 2 gets a bye
      } else if (team2Id === 'BYE') {
        nextRoundTeams.push(team1Id); // Team 1 gets a bye
      } else {
        // Normal match
        generatedMatches.push({
          id: uuidv4(),
          team1Id: team1Id,
          team2Id: team2Id,
          matchStateId: null,
          result: null,
          isPlayed: false,
          round: roundNum,
          matchNumber: generatedMatches.length + 1,
        });
        nextRoundTeams.push(`TBD-R${roundNum + 1}-M${(i / 2) + 1}`); // Placeholder for winner
      }
    }
    currentRoundTeams = nextRoundTeams;
    roundNum++;
  }
  bracket.push(currentRoundTeams); // The winner
  return { generatedMatches, generatedBracket: bracket };
};

/**
 * Updates tournament standings for a round-robin format.
 */
export const updateRoundRobinStandings = (
  teamIds: string[],
  currentStandings: { [teamId: string]: TournamentTeamStats },
  match: TournamentMatch,
  team1: Team, // Full team objects to access player data if NRR is complex
  team2: Team,
  matchState: MatchState,
) => {
  if (!match.result) return currentStandings;

  const s1 = currentStandings[match.team1Id] || { teamId: match.team1Id, played: 0, won: 0, lost: 0, drawn: 0, points: 0, nrr: 0 };
  const s2 = currentStandings[match.team2Id] || { teamId: match.team2Id, played: 0, won: 0, lost: 0, drawn: 0, points: 0, nrr: 0 };

  s1.played++;
  s2.played++;

  const innings1 = matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]]; // Assuming first innings is 0
  const innings2 = matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[1]]; // Assuming second innings is 1

  const team1Score = innings1?.score || 0;
  const team2Score = innings2?.score || 0;
  const team1Overs = innings1 ? (innings1.legalBalls / 6) : 0;
  const team2Overs = innings2 ? (innings2.legalBalls / 6) : 0;

  switch (match.result.type) {
    case MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS:
      if (match.result.winningTeamId === match.team1Id) {
        s1.won++;
        s1.points += 2;
        s2.lost++;
      } else {
        s2.won++;
        s2.points += 2;
        s1.lost++;
      }
      break;
    case MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS:
      if (match.result.winningTeamId === match.team1Id) {
        s1.won++;
        s1.points += 2;
        s2.lost++;
      } else {
        s2.won++;
        s2.points += 2;
        s1.lost++;
      }
      break;
    case MatchResultType.TIE:
    case MatchResultType.DRAW: // In round robin, a draw usually gives points
      s1.drawn++;
      s1.points += 1;
      s2.drawn++;
      s2.points += 1;
      break;
    default:
      // No result or other cases
      break;
  }

  const team1NRR = (team1Score / Math.max(1, team1Overs)) - (team2Score / Math.max(1, team2Overs));
  s1.nrr += team1NRR;

  const team2NRR = (team2Score / Math.max(1, team2Overs)) - (team1Score / Math.max(1, team1Overs));
  s2.nrr += team2NRR;


  return {
    ...currentStandings,
    [match.team1Id]: s1,
    [match.team2Id]: s2,
  };
};


/**
 * Sorts tournament standings for display.
 */
export const sortStandings = (standings: TournamentTeamStats[]): TournamentTeamStats[] => {
  return [...standings].sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.points !== a.points) {
      return b.points - a.points;
    }
    // Tie-breaker: NRR (Net Run Rate)
    return b.nrr - a.nrr;
  });
};
