--- START FILE: src\__tests__\ai.test.ts ---

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import type { SpyInstance } from 'vitest'; // FIX #3: Explicitly import SpyInstance type
import { decideBattingRoll, decideBowlingRoll } from '../utils/ai';
import { Difficulty, MatchState, GameFormat, TossDecision, MatchStage } from '../types';
import { DICE_MIN_VALUE, DICE_MAX_VALUE } from '../utils/constants';

// Mock MatchState for decideBattingRoll if needed
const mockMatchState: MatchState = {
  id: 'mock-match',
  format: { type: GameFormat.T20, overs: 20, wickets: 10, inningsPerSide: 1 },
  team1Id: 'mock-team-1',
  team2Id: 'mock-team-2',
  team1Players: [],
  team2Players: [],
  tossWinnerId: 'mock-team-1',
  tossDecision: TossDecision.BAT,
  currentInnings: 1,
  innings: {}, // Empty for basic tests
  isUserBatting: false,
  isUserBowler: true,
  currentMatchStage: MatchStage.FIRST_INNINGS,
  target: 0,
  settings: {
    difficulty: Difficulty.EASY,
    enableDiceAnimation: false,
    enableSoundEffects: false,
    enableExtras: false,
    theme: 'light',
  },
  result: null,
  commentaryLog: [],
  createdAt: Date.now(),
  lastPlayedAt: Date.now(),
  status: 'active',
};

describe('AI Functions', () => {
  let mockRandom: SpyInstance; // FIX #3: Use imported SpyInstance type

  beforeEach(() => {
    // Mock Math.random for predictable results in distribution checks
    mockRandom = vi.spyOn(Math, 'random');
  });

  it('decideBowlingRoll should return a number between 1 and 6', () => {
    mockRandom.mockReturnValue(0.5); // Ensure it always returns a value within range
    const roll = decideBowlingRoll([], Difficulty.EASY);
    expect(roll).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(DICE_MIN_VALUE);
    expect(roll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(DICE_MAX_VALUE);
  });

  it('decideBattingRoll should return a number between 1 and 6', () => {
    mockRandom.mockReturnValue(0.5);
    const roll = decideBattingRoll(mockMatchState, Difficulty.EASY);
    expect(roll).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(DICE_MIN_VALUE);
    expect(roll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(DICE_MAX_VALUE);
  });

  describe('decideBowlingRoll difficulty', () => {
    it('EASY difficulty should be fairly uniform (no strong bias)', () => {
      const history = [1, 1, 1, 2, 3]; // Bias for 1
      const rolls = Array(1000)
        .fill(0)
        .map(() => {
          mockRandom.mockReturnValue(Math.random()); // Allow actual randomness for distribution test
          return decideBowlingRoll(history, Difficulty.EASY);
        });

      const counts = rolls.reduce((acc, r) => {
        acc[r] = (acc[r] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, number>);

      // For EASY, all should be roughly equal (166-167 for 1000 rolls)
      for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
        expect(counts[i]).toBeGreaterThan(100);
        expect(counts[i]).toBeLessThan(250);
      }
    });

    it('HARD difficulty should show a bias towards recent batsman tendencies (e.g., most frequent roll)', () => {
      const history = [4, 4, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 4]; // Batsman frequently rolls 4
      const hardRolls = Array(5000)
        .fill(0)
        .map(() => {
          mockRandom.mockReturnValue(Math.random());
          return decideBowlingRoll(history, Difficulty.HARD);
        });

      const counts = hardRolls.reduce((acc, r) => {
        acc[r] = (acc[r] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, number>);

      // Expect '4' to be significantly higher than others
      const count4 = counts[4] || 0;
      let othersSum = 0;
      for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
        if (i !== 4) {
          othersSum += counts[i] || 0;
        }
      }
      const avgOthers = othersSum / (DICE_MAX_VALUE - 1);

      // A bias of 0.1 for HARD should make '4' roughly (1/6 + 0.1) * 5000 = 833 + 500 = 1333
      // And others (1/6 - 0.1/5) * 5000 = (0.166 - 0.02) * 5000 = 0.146 * 5000 = 730
      expect(count4).toBeGreaterThan(1000); // Expect '4' to be significantly higher
      expect(avgOthers).toBeLessThan(800);
      expect(count4).toBeGreaterThan(avgOthers); // '4' should be more frequent than average of others
    });
  });

  describe('decideBattingRoll difficulty', () => {
    it('EASY difficulty should be fairly uniform', () => {
      const rolls = Array(1000)
        .fill(0)
        .map(() => {
          mockRandom.mockReturnValue(Math.random());
          return decideBattingRoll(mockMatchState, Difficulty.EASY);
        });

      const counts = rolls.reduce((acc, r) => {
        acc[r] = (acc[r] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, number>);

      for (let i = DICE_MIN_VALUE; i <= DICE_MAX_VALUE; i++) {
        expect(counts[i]).toBeGreaterThan(100);
        expect(counts[i]).toBeLessThan(250);
      }
    });

    it('HARD difficulty should show a bias towards higher scores (4, 5, 6)', () => {
      const hardMatchState = { ...mockMatchState, settings: { ...mockMatchState.settings, difficulty: Difficulty.HARD } };
      const rolls = Array(5000)
        .fill(0)
        .map(() => {
          mockRandom.mockReturnValue(Math.random());
          return decideBattingRoll(hardMatchState, Difficulty.HARD);
        });

      const counts = rolls.reduce((acc, r) => {
        acc[r] = (acc[r] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, number>);

      const highScoresCount = (counts[4] || 0) + (counts[5] || 0) + (counts[6] || 0);
      const lowScoresCount = (counts[1] || 0) + (counts[2] || 0) + (counts[3] || 0);

      // For HARD, higher scores should be more frequent
      // Each of 4,5,6 has bias +0.06/3 = +0.02. Total (1/6+0.02)*5000 = 933
      // Each of 1,2,3 has bias -0.06/3 = -0.02. Total (1/6-0.02)*5000 = 733
      expect(counts[4]).toBeGreaterThan(800);
      expect(counts[5]).toBeGreaterThan(800);
      expect(counts[6]).toBeGreaterThan(800);
      expect(counts[1]).toBeLessThan(800);
      expect(counts[2]).toBeLessThan(800);
      expect(counts[3]).toBeLessThan(800);

      expect(highScoresCount).toBeGreaterThan(lowScoresCount);
    });

    it('HARD difficulty aggressive bias for target chase should further increase high scores', () => {
        const aggressiveMatchState: MatchState = {
            ...mockMatchState,
            settings: { ...mockMatchState.settings, difficulty: Difficulty.HARD },
            currentMatchStage: MatchStage.SECOND_INNINGS,
            target: 100,
            innings: {
                'innings-2-id': {
                    id: 'innings-2-id',
                    teamId: 'mock-team-2', // AI is batting
                    score: 80, // Needs 20 runs
                    wickets: 5,
                    balls: 80,
                    legalBalls: 80, // 80 balls, so 13.2 overs (20 overs total) -> 40 balls remaining
                    extras: 0, battingOrder: [], currentBatsmanId: null, secondBatsmanId: null, currentBowlerId: null, fallOfWickets: [], individualScores: {}, bowlingStats: {}, history: [], isCompleted: false
                }
            } as any
        };

        const rolls = Array(5000).fill(0).map(() => {
            mockRandom.mockReturnValue(Math.random());
            return decideBattingRoll(aggressiveMatchState, Difficulty.HARD);
        });

        const counts = rolls.reduce((acc, r) => {
            acc[r] = (acc[r] || 0) + 1;
            return acc;
        }, {} as Record<number, number>);

        // With aggressive bias (+0.05 for 5,6)
        // Original: (1/6 + 0.02) for 4,5,6
        // Aggressive: (1/6 + 0.02 + 0.05/2) = (0.166 + 0.02 + 0.025) = 0.211 * 5000 = ~1055 for 5,6
        // 4: (1/6+0.02)*5000 = ~933
        // 1,2: (1/6 - 0.02 - 0.05/2) = (0.166 - 0.02 - 0.025) = 0.121 * 5000 = ~605
        // 3: (1/6 - 0.02) = ~733
        expect(counts[6]).toBeGreaterThan(counts[5]); // 6 should be higher due to double bias
        expect(counts[5]).toBeGreaterThan(counts[4]); // 5 should be higher than 4
        expect(counts[4]).toBeGreaterThan(counts[3]);
        expect(counts[3]).toBeGreaterThan(counts[2]);
        expect(counts[2]).toBeGreaterThan(counts[1]);

        expect(counts[6]).toBeGreaterThan(1000); // Strongly biased
        expect(counts[5]).toBeGreaterThan(900);
        expect(counts[1]).toBeLessThan(700);
    });
  });
});

--- END FILE: src\__tests__\ai.test.ts ---

--- START FILE: src\__tests__\gameEngine.test.ts ---

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import {
  initializeMatch,
  resolveBall,
  checkInningsEnd,
  transitionInnings,
  calculateMatchResult,
  simulateFullMatch,
} from '../utils/gameEngine';
import {
  MatchState,
  GameFormat,
  Team,
  TossDecision,
  MatchStage,
  MatchResultType,
  Difficulty,
  GameSettings,
  Player,
} from '../types';
import { DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS, OVERS_PER_OVER, MAX_WICKETS } from '../utils/constants';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// Mock player and team data for consistency
const mockPlayer = (name: string, battingOrder: number): Player => ({
  id: uuidv4(),
  name: name,
  avatar: undefined,
  runs: 0,
  balls: 0,
  wickets: 0,
  overs: 0,
  maidens: 0,
  isOut: false,
  battingOrder: battingOrder,
});

const mockTeam = (id: string, name: string, numPlayers: number = 11): Team => ({
  id: id,
  name: name,
  players: Array.from({ length: numPlayers }, (_, i) =>
    mockPlayer(`${name} Player ${i + 1}`, i + 1),
  ),
});

const teamA = mockTeam('teamA-id', 'Team A');
const teamB = mockTeam('teamB-id', 'Team B');

const defaultSettings: GameSettings = {
  difficulty: Difficulty.EASY,
  enableDiceAnimation: false,
  enableSoundEffects: false,
  enableExtras: false,
  theme: 'light',
};

describe('gameEngine', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Reset mocks or setup before each test if necessary
  });

  describe('initializeMatch', () => {
    it('should initialize a T20 match correctly with user winning toss and batting', () => {
      const matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA, // User team
        teamB, // AI team
        true, // User wins toss
        TossDecision.BAT, // User bats (FIX #2: Use enum)
        defaultSettings,
      );

      expect(matchState.format.type).toBe(GameFormat.T20);
      expect(matchState.team1Id).toBe(teamA.id);
      expect(matchState.team2Id).toBe(teamB.id);
      expect(matchState.tossWinnerId).toBe(teamA.id);
      expect(matchState.tossDecision).toBe(TossDecision.BAT); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(matchState.currentInnings).toBe(1);
      expect(matchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.FIRST_INNINGS); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(matchState.isUserBatting).toBe(true);
      expect(matchState.isUserBowler).toBe(false);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings).length).toBe(1);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].teamId).toBe(teamA.id);
    });

    it('should initialize an ODI match correctly with AI winning toss and bowling', () => {
      const matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.ODI],
        teamA, // User team
        teamB, // AI team
        false, // AI wins toss
        null, // User decision not relevant
        { ...defaultSettings, difficulty: Difficulty.HARD }, // AI will try to bat first
      );

      expect(matchState.format.type).toBe(GameFormat.ODI);
      expect(matchState.tossWinnerId).toBe(teamB.id);
      expect(matchState.tossDecision).toBe(TossDecision.BAT); // AI bats first for HARD (FIX #2: Use enum)
      expect(matchState.isUserBatting).toBe(false);
      expect(matchState.isUserBowler).toBe(true);
      expect(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].teamId).toBe(teamB.id);
    });
  });

  describe('resolveBall', () => {
    let matchState: MatchState;

    beforeEach(() => {
      matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        true,
        TossDecision.BAT, // FIX #2: Use enum
        defaultSettings,
      );
    });

    it('should add runs if batsman and bowler rolls do not match', () => {
      const initialScore = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].score;
      const initialBalls = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].legalBalls;
      const batsmanRoll = 4;
      const bowlerRoll = 2;

      const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
        matchState,
        batsmanRoll,
        bowlerRoll,
        true,
      );
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(initialScore + batsmanRoll);
      expect(currentInnings.wickets).toBe(0);
      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(initialBalls + 1);
      expect(ballOutcome?.isWicket).toBe(false);
      expect(ballOutcome?.runsScored).toBe(batsmanRoll);
      expect(updatedMatchState.commentaryLog.length).toBeGreaterThan(matchState.commentaryLog.length);
    });

    it('should register a wicket if batsman and bowler rolls match', () => {
      const initialScore = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].score;
      const initialWickets = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].wickets;
      const initialBalls = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].legalBalls;
      const batsmanRoll = 3;
      const bowlerRoll = 3;

      const { updatedMatchState, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(
        matchState,
        batsmanRoll,
        bowlerRoll,
        true,
      );
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(initialScore); // No runs scored
      expect(currentInnings.wickets).toBe(initialWickets + 1);
      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(initialBalls + 1);
      expect(ballOutcome?.isWicket).toBe(true);
      expect(ballOutcome?.runsScored).toBe(0);
      expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).not.toBe(Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId); // New batsman
      expect(currentInnings.fallOfWickets.length).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should swap strike for odd runs', () => {
        const initialBatsman = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId;
        const initialNonStriker = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].secondBatsmanId;

        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(matchState, 1, 2, true); // 1 run
        const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

        expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).toBe(initialNonStriker);
        expect(currentInnings.secondBatsmanId).toBe(initialBatsman);
    });

    it('should not swap strike for even runs', () => {
        const initialBatsman = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].currentBatsmanId;
        const initialNonStriker = Object.values(matchState.innings)[0].secondBatsmanId;

        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(matchState, 2, 1, true); // 2 runs
        const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

        expect(currentInnings.currentBatsmanId).toBe(initialBatsman);
        expect(currentInnings.secondBatsmanId).toBe(initialNonStriker);
    });

    it('should handle end of over and rotate bowler', () => {
      // Simulate 5 balls
      let currentState = matchState;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(currentState, 1, 2, true);
        currentState = updatedMatchState;
      }

      const initialBowler = Object.values(currentState.innings)[0].currentBowlerId;
      const { updatedMatchState } = resolveBall(currentState, 1, 2, true); // 6th ball
      const currentInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[0];

      expect(currentInnings.legalBalls % OVERS_PER_OVER).toBe(0); // Over completed
      expect(currentInnings.currentBowlerId).not.toBe(initialBowler); // Bowler rotated
    });

    it('should count an extra (wide) and re-bowl without incrementing legal balls', () => {
        const settingsWithExtras = { ...defaultSettings, enableExtras: true };
        let state = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, settingsWithExtras); // FIX #2: Use enum

        // Mock Math.random to force an extra
        const originalMathRandom = Math.random;
        Math.random = () => 0.01; // Force extra, then force wide
        let { updatedMatchState: stateAfterExtra, ballOutcome } = resolveBall(state, 1, 2, true);
        Math.random = originalMathRandom; // Restore Math.random

        const currentInnings = Object.values(stateAfterExtra.innings)[0];

        expect(ballOutcome?.isExtra).toBe(true);
        expect(ballOutcome?.extraType).toBe('WIDE');
        expect(currentInnings.extras).toBe(1);
        expect(currentInnings.score).toBe(1);
        expect(currentInnings.balls).toBe(1); // Total balls incremented
        expect(currentInnings.legalBalls).toBe(0); // Legal balls not incremented
        expect(stateAfterExtra.commentaryLog[stateAfterExtra.commentaryLog.length -1]).toContain('Wide!');

        // Now bowl a normal ball
        const { updatedMatchState: stateAfterNormalBall } = resolveBall(stateAfterExtra, 4, 2, true);
        const nextInnings = Object.values(stateAfterNormalBall.innings)[0];
        expect(nextInnings.legalBalls).toBe(1); // Legal ball now counted
        expect(nextInnings.balls).toBe(2); // Total balls is 2 (1 extra, 1 legal)
        expect(nextInnings.score).toBe(1 + 4); // Score is 1 (extra) + 4 (batsman roll)
    });
  });

  describe('checkInningsEnd', () => {
    let innings: any; // Using 'any' for simpler modification for test cases
    const format = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20];

    beforeEach(() => {
      innings = {
        score: 0,
        wickets: 0,
        legalBalls: 0,
        battingOrder: teamA.players.map(p => p.id), // Ensure batting order is present
      };
    });

    it('should return false if neither wickets nor overs limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = 5;
      innings.legalBalls = 10 * OVERS_PER_OVER; // 10 overs
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return true if wickets limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = MAX_WICKETS;
      innings.legalBalls = 5 * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return true if overs limit is reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = 5;
      innings.legalBalls = format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should return true if all players are out (even if wickets < MAX_WICKETS due to small team)', () => {
        const smallTeamInnings = { ...innings, battingOrder: teamA.players.slice(0, 5).map(p => p.id) }; // 5 players
        smallTeamInnings.wickets = 4; // 5th player (index 4) is out if 4 wickets fall
        smallTeamInnings.legalBalls = 10;
        expect(checkInningsEnd(smallTeamInnings, { ...format, wickets: 10 })).toBe(true); // Should be true even if wickets is less than 10
    });

    it('should return true if both limits are reached', () => {
      innings.wickets = MAX_WICKETS;
      innings.legalBalls = format.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      expect(checkInningsEnd(innings, format)).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('transitionInnings', () => {
    let matchState: MatchState;

    beforeEach(() => {
      matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        true,
        TossDecision.BAT, // FIX #2: Use enum
        defaultSettings,
      );
      // Simulate first innings completion
      const currentInningsId = Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0];
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].score = 150;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].wickets = 5;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      matchState.innings[currentInningsId].isCompleted = true; // Manually set for test
    });

    it('should transition to second innings and set target for 1-innings-per-side format', () => {
      const updatedMatchState = transitionInnings(matchState);

      expect(updatedMatchState.currentInnings).toBe(2);
      expect(updatedMatchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.INNINGS_BREAK); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(updatedMatchState.target).toBe(151);
      expect(Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings).length).toBe(2);
      const secondInnings = Object.values(updatedMatchState.innings)[1];
      expect(secondInnings.teamId).toBe(teamB.id); // Team B should be batting now
      expect(updatedMatchState.isUserBatting).toBe(false); // User team (A) was batting
    });

    it('should transition to MATCH_OVER after second innings completion for 1-innings-per-side format', () => {
      let state = transitionInnings(matchState); // First innings to second
      const secondInningsId = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
      state.innings[secondInningsId].score = 100;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].wickets = 3;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      state.innings[secondInningsId].isCompleted = true;

      const finalMatchState = transitionInnings(state);

      expect(finalMatchState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(finalMatchState.result).not.toBeNull();
      expect(finalMatchState.status).toBe('completed');
    });

    it('should transition to 3rd innings for TEST format after 2nd innings completion', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings); // FIX #2: Use enum

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;

        let stateAfter1st = transitionInnings(testMatchState);
        expect(stateAfter1st.currentInnings).toBe(2); // Team B's 1st innings

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(stateAfter1st.innings)[1];
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        stateAfter1st.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;

        let stateAfter2nd = transitionInnings(stateAfter1st);
        expect(stateAfter2nd.currentInnings).toBe(3); // Team A's 2nd innings
        expect(Object.values(stateAfter2nd.innings).length).toBe(3);
        expect(Object.values(stateAfter2nd.innings)[2].teamId).toBe(teamA.id);
    });

    it('should transition to 4th innings for TEST format after 3rd innings completion', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings); // FIX #2: Use enum

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;
        let state = transitionInnings(testMatchState);

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
        state.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        state.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 3rd innings (Team A)
        const innings3Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[2];
        state.innings[innings3Id].score = 100; // Team A sets a target
        state.innings[innings3Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings3Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        expect(state.currentInnings).toBe(4); // Team B's 2nd innings
        expect(Object.values(state.innings).length).toBe(4);
        expect(Object.values(state.innings)[3].teamId).toBe(teamB.id);
        // Target calculation for test match 4th innings: (T1_I1 + T1_I3) - T2_I2 + 1
        // (200 + 100) - 150 + 1 = 151
        expect(state.target).toBe(151);
    });

    it('should transition to MATCH_OVER after 4th innings completion for TEST format', () => {
        let testMatchState = initializeMatch(DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST], teamA, teamB, true, TossDecision.BAT, defaultSettings); // FIX #2: Use enum

        // Simulate 1st innings (Team A)
        const innings1Id = Object.keys(testMatchState.innings)[0];
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 200;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        testMatchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;
        let state = transitionInnings(testMatchState);

        // Simulate 2nd innings (Team B)
        const innings2Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[1];
        state.innings[innings2Id].score = 150;
        state.innings[innings2Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings2Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 3rd innings (Team A)
        const innings3Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[2];
        state.innings[innings3Id].score = 100;
        state.innings[innings3Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings3Id].isCompleted = true;
        state = transitionInnings(state);

        // Simulate 4th innings (Team B)
        const innings4Id = Object.keys(state.innings)[3];
        state.innings[innings4Id].score = 150; // Team B scores 150, target was 151
        state.innings[innings4Id].wickets = MAX_WICKETS; // Assume all out or overs finished
        state.innings[innings4Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
        state.innings[innings4Id].isCompleted = true;
        state.target = 151; // Set target for the test

        let finalState = transitionInnings(state);
        expect(finalState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER); // FIX #2: Use enum
        expect(finalState.result).not.toBeNull();
        expect(finalState.result?.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS); // Team A wins by 1 run (300-299)
        expect(finalState.status).toBe('completed');
    });
  });

  describe('calculateMatchResult', () => {
    // Helper to create a basic match state for result calculation
    const createCompletedMatchState = (
      team1Score: number,
      team2Score: number,
      format: GameFormat,
      battingFirstTeamId: string, // ID of the team that batted first
      team2Wickets?: number, // Wickets lost by team2 (for win by wickets)
      inningsPerSide: number = 1,
      inningsData?: { team1_I1: { score: number }, team2_I1: { score: number }, team1_I2: { score: number }, team2_I2: { score: number, wickets: number } }
    ): MatchState => {
      const matchFormat = { ...DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[format], inningsPerSide };
      const innings1Id = uuidv4();
      const innings2Id = uuidv4();
      const initialInnings: { [id: string]: any } = {
        [innings1Id]: {
          id: innings1Id,
          teamId: battingFirstTeamId,
          score: team1Score,
          wickets: MAX_WICKETS, // Assume all out or overs completed
          legalBalls: matchFormat.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER,
          isCompleted: true,
          history: [], individualScores: {}, bowlingStats: {}, extras: 0, battingOrder: teamA.players.map(p => p.id), currentBatsmanId: null, secondBatsmanId: null, currentBowlerId: null, fallOfWickets: []
        },
      };

      if (inningsPerSide === 1) {
          initialInnings[innings2Id] = {
              id: innings2Id,
              teamId: battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id,
              score: team2Score,
              wickets: team2Wickets !== undefined ? team2Wickets : MAX_WICKETS,
              legalBalls: matchFormat.overs * OVERS_PER_OVER,
              isCompleted: true,
              history: [], individualScores: {}, bowlingStats: {}, extras: 0, battingOrder: teamB.players.map(p => p.id), currentBatsmanId: null, secondBatsmanId: null, currentBowlerId: null, fallOfWickets: []
          };
      } else if (inningsPerSide === 2 && inningsData) {
        // For Test matches, need 4 innings
        const innings3Id = uuidv4();
        const innings4Id = uuidv4();

        initialInnings[innings2Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: uuidv4(), teamId: (battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id), score: inningsData.team2_I1.score, battingOrder: teamB.players.map(p => p.id) };
        initialInnings[innings3Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: uuidv4(), teamId: battingFirstTeamId, score: inningsData.team1_I2.score, battingOrder: teamA.players.map(p => p.id) };
        initialInnings[innings4Id] = { ...initialInnings[innings1Id], id: uuidv4(), teamId: (battingFirstTeamId === teamA.id ? teamB.id : teamA.id), score: inningsData.team2_I2.score, wickets: inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, battingOrder: teamB.players.map(p => p.id) };
      }

      return {
        id: uuidv4(),
        format: matchFormat,
        team1Id: teamA.id,
        team2Id: teamB.id,
        team1Players: teamA.players,
        team2Players: teamB.players,
        tossWinnerId: battingFirstTeamId,
        tossDecision: TossDecision.BAT, // FIX #2: Use enum
        currentInnings: inningsPerSide === 1 ? 2 : 4,
        innings: initialInnings,
        isUserBatting: false,
        isUserBowler: true,
        currentMatchStage: MatchStage.MATCH_OVER, // FIX #2: Use enum
        target: inningsPerSide === 1 ? team1Score + 1 : (inningsData ? (inningsData.team1_I1.score + inningsData.team1_I2.score - inningsData.team2_I1.score + 1) : 0),
        settings: defaultSettings,
        result: null,
        commentaryLog: [],
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastPlayedAt: Date.now(),
        status: 'completed',
      };
    };

    it('should correctly determine win by runs', () => {
      const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(150, 140, GameFormat.T20, teamA.id); // Team A batted first, scored 150. Team B chased 140.
      const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

      expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS);
      expect(result.winningTeamId).toBe(teamA.id);
      expect(result.runsDifference).toBe(10);
      expect(result.message).toContain('wins by 10 runs!');
    });

    it('should correctly determine win by wickets', () => {
      const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(150, 151, GameFormat.T20, teamA.id, 5); // Team B chased 151 with 5 wickets remaining
      const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

      expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS);
      expect(result.winningTeamId).toBe(teamB.id);
      expect(result.wicketsRemaining).toBe(MAX_WICKETS - 5); // 10 max wickets - 5 lost = 5 remaining
      expect(result.message).toContain('wins by 5 wickets!');
    });

    it('should correctly determine a tie', () => {
      const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(150, 150, GameFormat.T20, teamA.id);
      const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

      expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.TIE);
      expect(result.message).toBe("It's a tie!");
    });

    it('should correctly determine a Test match win by runs (Team A wins)', () => {
        // Team A: 200 (I1) + 150 (I3) = 350
        // Team B: 180 (I2) + 160 (I4) = 340
        const inningsData = {
            team1_I1: { score: 200 },
            team2_I1: { score: 180 },
            team1_I2: { score: 150 },
            team2_I2: { score: 160, wickets: MAX_WICKETS } // Team B all out
        };
        const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(
            inningsData.team1_I1.score, inningsData.team2_I2.score, GameFormat.TEST, teamA.id, inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, 2, inningsData
        );
        matchState.innings = {
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I2.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I2.score, wickets: inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 }
        } as any; // Cast to any to bypass strict type for test setup
        const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

        expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_RUNS);
        expect(result.winningTeamId).toBe(teamA.id);
        expect(result.runsDifference).toBe(10); // 350 - 340
    });

    it('should correctly determine a Test match win by wickets (Team B wins)', () => {
        // Team A: 200 (I1) + 150 (I3) = 350
        // Team B: 180 (I2) + 171 (I4 to chase 350 - 180 + 1 = 171) = 351 (total after chasing)
        const inningsData = {
            team1_I1: { score: 200 },
            team2_I1: { score: 180 },
            team1_I2: { score: 150 },
            team2_I2: { score: 171, wickets: 7 } // Team B chased target, lost 7 wickets
        };
        const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(
            inningsData.team1_I1.score, inningsData.team2_I2.score, GameFormat.TEST, teamA.id, inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, 2, inningsData
        );
        matchState.innings = {
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I2.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I2.score, wickets: inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 }
        } as any;
        matchState.target = (inningsData.team1_I1.score + inningsData.team1_I2.score) - inningsData.team2_I1.score + 1; // 350 - 180 + 1 = 171
        const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

        expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS);
        expect(result.winningTeamId).toBe(teamB.id);
        expect(result.wicketsRemaining).toBe(MAX_WICKETS - 7); // 3 wickets remaining
    });

    it('should correctly determine a Test match draw (overs finished, target not reached)', () => {
        // Team A: 200 (I1) + 150 (I3) = 350
        // Team B: 180 (I2) + 160 (I4) = 340, but didn't get all out and overs ran out
        const inningsData = {
            team1_I1: { score: 200 },
            team2_I1: { score: 180 },
            team1_I2: { score: 150 },
            team2_I2: { score: 160, wickets: 5 } // Team B still had wickets, but overs finished
        };
        const matchState = createCompletedMatchState(
            inningsData.team1_I1.score, inningsData.team2_I2.score, GameFormat.TEST, teamA.id, inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, 2, inningsData
        );
        matchState.innings = {
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I1.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamA.id, score: inningsData.team1_I2.score, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 },
            [uuidv4()]: { ...matchState.innings[Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0]], id: uuidv4(), teamId: teamB.id, score: inningsData.team2_I2.score, wickets: inningsData.team2_I2.wickets, isCompleted: true, legalBalls: 90*6 } // Overs run out, not all out
        } as any;
        matchState.target = (inningsData.team1_I1.score + inningsData.team1_I2.score) - inningsData.team2_I1.score + 1; // 171
        const result = calculateMatchResult(matchState);

        expect(result.type).toBe(MatchResultType.DRAW);
        expect(result.message).toContain('drawn');
    });
  });

  describe('simulateFullMatch', () => {
    it('should simulate a full T20 match to completion with a result', () => {
      let matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        false, // AI vs AI simulation, toss is random
        null,
        { ...defaultSettings, enableDiceAnimation: false, enableSoundEffects: false, difficulty: Difficulty.EASY },
      );

      const finalState = simulateFullMatch(matchState, teamA, teamB);

      expect(finalState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(finalState.status).toBe('completed');
      expect(finalState.result).not.toBeNull();
      expect(Object.values(finalState.innings).length).toBe(2); // Two innings for T20
      expect(Object.values(finalState.innings)[0].isCompleted).toBe(true);
      expect(Object.values(finalState.innings)[1].isCompleted).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should simulate a full Test match (4 innings) to completion with a result', () => {
        let matchState = initializeMatch(
            DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.TEST],
            teamA,
            teamB,
            false,
            null,
            { ...defaultSettings, enableDiceAnimation: false, enableSoundEffects: false, difficulty: Difficulty.EASY },
        );

        const finalState = simulateFullMatch(matchState, teamA, teamB);

        expect(finalState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER); // FIX #2: Use enum
        expect(finalState.status).toBe('completed');
        expect(finalState.result).not.toBeNull();
        expect(Object.values(finalState.innings).length).toBe(4); // Four innings for Test
        expect(Object.values(finalState.innings).every(i => i.isCompleted)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should correctly end a match if target is chased mid-innings during simulation', () => {
      let matchState = initializeMatch(
        DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20],
        teamA,
        teamB,
        true, // User wins toss
        TossDecision.BAT, // User bats (FIX #2: Use enum)
        { ...defaultSettings, enableDiceAnimation: false, enableSoundEffects: false, difficulty: Difficulty.EASY },
      );

      // Manually set a low target for quick chase simulation
      const innings1Id = Object.keys(matchState.innings)[0];
      matchState.innings[innings1Id].score = 50; // Team A sets a low target
      matchState.innings[innings1Id].wickets = MAX_WICKETS;
      matchState.innings[innings1Id].legalBalls = DEFAULT_MATCH_FORMATS[GameFormat.T20].overs * OVERS_PER_OVER;
      matchState.innings[innings1Id].isCompleted = true;

      let stateAfter1st = transitionInnings(matchState); // Transition to 2nd innings

      const finalState = simulateFullMatch(stateAfter1st, teamA, teamB);

      expect(finalState.currentMatchStage).toBe(MatchStage.MATCH_OVER); // FIX #2: Use enum
      expect(finalState.status).toBe('completed');
      expect(finalState.result).not.toBeNull();
      // Expect the second innings to have a score >= target, and wickets < MAX_WICKETS
      const secondInnings = Object.values(finalState.innings)[1];
      expect(secondInnings.score).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(finalState.target);
      expect(secondInnings.isCompleted).toBe(true);
      expect(finalState.result?.type).toBe(MatchResultType.WIN_BY_WICKETS);
    });
  });
});

--- END FILE: src\__tests__\gameEngine.test.ts ---
